"""Immutable bounded dependency DAG, reusable for claims, datasets and models."""
from collections import deque
from dataclasses import dataclass

from ..core.semantic_contracts import canonical_payload, load_json, require_fields, require_digest
from ..core.semantic_ir import fingerprint


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LineageGraph:
    manifest_json: str

    def __post_init__(self):
        data = load_json(self.manifest_json)
        require_fields(data, {"schema_version", "nodes"})
        if type(data["schema_version"]) is not int or data["schema_version"] != 1:
            raise ValueError("Unsupported lineage version")
        rows = data["nodes"]
        if not isinstance(rows, list) or not 1 <= len(rows) <= 4096:
            raise ValueError("Lineage requires 1–4096 nodes")
        nodes, links = {}, 0
        for row in rows:
            require_fields(row, {"id", "parents"})
            key = require_digest(row["id"])
            parents = row["parents"]
            if not isinstance(parents, list) or len(parents) > 256 or key in nodes:
                raise ValueError("Duplicate node or invalid parents")
            parents = [require_digest(parent) for parent in parents]
            if len(set(parents)) != len(parents):
                raise ValueError("Duplicate parent")
            nodes[key] = sorted(parents)
            links += len(parents)
        if links > 32768 or any(p not in nodes for parents in nodes.values() for p in parents):
            raise ValueError("Missing parent or link budget exceeded")
        children = {key: [] for key in nodes}
        degree = {key: len(parents) for key, parents in nodes.items()}
        for key, parents in nodes.items():
            for parent in parents:
                children[parent].append(key)
        pending = deque(key for key in nodes if not degree[key])
        visited = 0
        while pending:
            visited += 1
            for child in children[pending.popleft()]:
                degree[child] -= 1
                if not degree[child]:
                    pending.append(child)
        if visited != len(nodes):
            raise ValueError("Cyclic lineage")
        object.__setattr__(self, "manifest_json", canonical_payload({"schema_version": 1,
            "nodes": [{"id": key, "parents": nodes[key]} for key in sorted(nodes)]}))

    @classmethod
    def create(cls, nodes):
        return cls(canonical_payload({"schema_version": 1, "nodes": nodes}))

    def to_data(self):
        return load_json(self.manifest_json)

    @property
    def content_id(self):
        return fingerprint(self.to_data())

    def descendants(self, identifier):
        nodes = {row["id"]: row["parents"] for row in self.to_data()["nodes"]}
        require_digest(identifier)
        if identifier not in nodes:
            raise ValueError("Unknown lineage node")
        children = {key: [] for key in nodes}
        for key, parents in nodes.items():
            for parent in parents:
                children[parent].append(key)
        found, pending = set(), [identifier]
        while pending:
            for child in children[pending.pop()]:
                if child not in found:
                    found.add(child)
                    pending.append(child)
        return tuple(sorted(found))

    def from_data(cls,data):

            entries.append(LiteratureEntry(**row))
        return cls(entries,provenance=data['provenance'])

    def search(self, query, *, limit=10):

            raise ValueError('Consulta ou limite inválido')

        hits=[]
        for entry in self.entries:
            text=' '.join((entry.citation.title,entry.summary,*entry.keywords)).casefold()

            if score:
                hits.append({'entry':entry.to_data(),'matched_terms':score})
        hits.sort(key=lambda h:(-h['matched_terms'],h['entry']['citation']['key']))
        payload={'query':query,'corpus_id':self.corpus_id,'corpus_provenance':self.provenance,
                 'entries_consulted':len(self.entries),'hits':hits[:limit],
                 'scope':'local supplied metadata snapshot; no global literature or priority claim',
                 'source_authentication_performed':False}
        return {**payload,'query_id':fingerprint(payload)}

def assess_relative_novelty(hypothesis, corpus, *, query, reviewer, references_consulted):
    references_consulted = tuple(references_consulted)
    known = {entry.citation.key for entry in corpus.entries}
    if not isinstance(reviewer, str) or not reviewer.strip() or len(set(references_consulted)) != len(references_consulted) or not set(references_consulted) <= known:

               'reviewer': reviewer, 'references_consulted': list(references_consulted),
               'review_coverage': len(references_consulted) / len(known) if known else None,
               'review_authentication': 'operator_declaration', 'global_novelty_established': False}
    return {**payload, 'assessment_id': fingerprint(payload)}

class ReviewBoard:
    def __init__(self,reviewers,*,authors):
        reviewers=tuple(reviewers);self.reviewers={r.reviewer_id:r for r in reviewers}
        if len(self.reviewers)!=len(reviewers):raise ValueError('Revisor duplicado')
        self.authors={key:tuple(value) for key,value in authors.items()};self._reviews=[];self._latest={}

    def submit(self,review,ledger):
        ledger.get(review.revision_id)
        known={key for revision in ledger.revisions for key in revision.evidence}
        if not set(review.evidence)<=known:raise ValueError('Evidência de revisão ausente do histórico')
        reviewer=self.reviewers[review.reviewer_id];authors=self.authors.get(review.revision_id)
        if not authors or reviewer.reviewer_id in authors or set(authors)&set(reviewer.conflicts_with):
            raise ValueError('Autoria não declarada, autorrevisão ou conflito conhecido')
        if review.domain not in reviewer.domains:
            raise ValueError('Especialidade não declarada')
        key=(review.revision_id,review.reviewer_id)
        if review.previous!=self._latest.get(key):raise ValueError('Histórico de revisão divergente')
        self._reviews.append(review);self._latest[key]=review.review_id
        return review.review_id

    def decision(self,revision_id,*,minimum=2):
        if type(minimum) is not int or not 2<=minimum<=100:raise ValueError('Pelo menos dois revisores requeridos')
        current=[r for r in self._reviews if r.revision_id==revision_id and self._latest[(r.revision_id,r.reviewer_id)]==r.review_id]
        accepted=sum(r.decision=='accept' for r in current)
        return {'revision_id':revision_id,'accepts':accepted,'reviewers':len(current),
                'recommended':accepted>=minimum and all(r.decision=='accept' for r in current),
                'reviews':[r.to_data() for r in current],'claim_status_changed':False,
                'identity_and_expertise_independently_authenticated':False}

def submit_signed_review(board,envelope,ledger,trust):
    """Authenticate a pinned reviewer key before applying the existing role policy.

    The key identity is authenticated. Expertise, independence and authorship
    declarations still need external review; signatures cannot establish them.
    """
    from .identity import _crypto
    from ..core.semantic_ir import canonical_json
    _,public,_=_crypto()
    from cryptography.exceptions import InvalidSignature
    if set(envelope)!={'schema_version','context','public_key','review','signature'} or envelope['schema_version']!=1 or envelope['context']!='Nabla-scientific-review-v1':
        raise ValueError('Contrato de assinatura de revisão inválido')
    data=dict(envelope['review']);identifier=data.pop('review_id');review=Review(**data)
    if review.review_id!=identifier or not trust.accepts(review.reviewer_id,envelope['public_key']):
        raise ValueError('Revisão alterada ou chave do revisor não confiável')
    payload={k:v for k,v in envelope.items() if k!='signature'}
    try:
        public.from_public_bytes(bytes.fromhex(envelope['public_key'])).verify(bytes.fromhex(envelope['signature']),canonical_json(payload).encode('utf-8'))
    except (ValueError,TypeError,InvalidSignature) as exc:raise ValueError('Assinatura de revisão inválida') from exc
    result=board.submit(review,ledger)
    return {'review_id':result,'reviewer_key_authenticated':True,'real_world_identity_and_expertise_verified':False,

"""Content-addressed evidence and bounded independent replay of supported artifacts."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
import json
from ..core.semantic_ir import canonical_json,fingerprint
from ..core.units import Quantity,Unit


def restore_quantities(value):
    if isinstance(value,dict):
        if set(value)=={'value','unit'} and isinstance(value['unit'],dict):
            unit=value['unit']
            return Quantity(value['value'],Unit(tuple(unit['dimensions']),unit['scale']))
        return {k:restore_quantities(v) for k,v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value,list):return [restore_quantities(v) for v in value]
    return value


def replay_domain(report):
    from ..domains.engineering import axial_bar,cantilever_tip
    from ..domains.materials import thermoelastic
    from ..domains.chemistry import balance_reaction,two_species_equilibrium
    from ..domains.earth import hydrostatic_pressure
    from ..domains.biology import logistic,sir
    from ..domains.control import StateSpace
    from ..domains.circuits import rc_step, series_rlc
    from ..domains.materials import isotropic_elasticity
    from ..domains.earth import layered_hydrostatics
    from ..domains.chemistry import reversible_first_order
    from ..worlds.multiphysics import electrothermal
    operations={'isotropic_small_strain_3d':isotropic_elasticity,'ideal_series_RLC_phasor':series_rlc,
                'layered_static_hydrostatics':layered_hydrostatics,'ideal_reversible_first_order':reversible_first_order,
                'ideal_series_RC_step':rc_step,'linear_axial_bar':axial_bar,'euler_bernoulli_cantilever':cantilever_tip,
                'linear_thermoelasticity':thermoelastic,'neutral_elemental_balance':balance_reaction,
                'ideal_A_to_B_equilibrium':two_species_equilibrium,'constant_density_hydrostatics':hydrostatic_pressure,
                'continuous_logistic_population':logistic,'closed_normalized_SIR':sir,
                'linear_current_driven_electrothermal':electrothermal}
    inputs=restore_quantities(report['inputs'])
    if report['model']=='normalized_continuous_siso':
        actual=StateSpace(inputs['A'],inputs['B'],inputs['C'],inputs['D']).analyze()
    else:
        actual=operations[report['model']](**inputs)
    return canonical_json(actual)==canonical_json(report) and actual['checks_passed']


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Evidence:
    kind: str
    payload_json: str
    provenance: str
    license_id: str
    synthetic: bool

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.kind not in {'domain_result','exact_trace','formal_certificate','observation','literature','refutation','discovery','policy'}:
            raise ValueError('Tipo de evidência desconhecido')
        if not self.provenance.strip() or not self.license_id.strip() or type(self.synthetic) is not bool or len(self.payload_json.encode())>16*1024*1024:
            raise ValueError('Metadados de evidência inválidos')
        object.__setattr__(self,'payload_json',canonical_json(json.loads(self.payload_json)))

    @property
    def payload(self):return json.loads(self.payload_json)

    @property
    def evidence_id(self):return fingerprint(self.to_data())

    def to_data(self):
        return {'kind':self.kind,'payload':self.payload,'provenance':self.provenance,
                'license_id':self.license_id,'synthetic':self.synthetic}

    @classmethod
    def from_data(cls,data):
        return cls(data['kind'],canonical_json(data['payload']),data['provenance'],data['license_id'],data['synthetic'])

    def verify(self):
        try:
            data=self.payload
            if self.kind=='domain_result':
                valid=replay_domain(data);method='domain_reexecution'
            elif self.kind=='exact_trace':
                from ..verify.trace import VerificationTrace
                trace=VerificationTrace.from_data(data)
                valid=trace.to_data()['verification']['valid'];method='independent_exact_trace'
            elif self.kind=='formal_certificate':
                from ..verify.certificate import verify_formal_certificate
                valid=verify_formal_certificate(data);method='formal_backend_reexecution'
            elif self.kind=='literature':
                from .literature import LiteratureCorpus
                corpus=LiteratureCorpus.from_data(data['corpus'])
                actual=corpus.search(data['query']['query'],limit=data.get('limit',10))
                valid=canonical_json(actual)==canonical_json(data['query']);method='local_corpus_query_reexecution'
            elif self.kind=='refutation':
                from ..falsifier.search import investigate
                actual=investigate(data['left'],data['right'],radius=data['radius'],budget=data['budget'])
                valid=canonical_json(actual)==canonical_json(data);method='bounded_refutation_reexecution'
            elif self.kind=='discovery':
                from ..discovery.research_program import verify_research
                valid=verify_research(data);method='research_reexecution'
            elif self.kind=='policy':
                from ..evolution.release_gate import verify_policy_receipt
                valid=verify_policy_receipt(data);method='analytic_policy_reexecution_no_issuer_authentication'
            else:
                # Measurement values are declarations, never verified physical facts.
                valid=isinstance(data,dict) and bool(data);method='content_integrity_only'
            return {'valid':bool(valid),'method':method,'evidence_id':self.evidence_id,
                    'external_provenance_authenticated':False}
        except (ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,ArithmeticError,RuntimeError):
            return {'valid':False,'method':'replay_failed','evidence_id':self.evidence_id,
                    'external_provenance_authenticated':False}


def audit_ledger(ledger,evidence):
    evidence=dict(evidence)
    if len(evidence)>1000 or len(ledger.revisions)>10000:raise ValueError('Auditoria excede orçamento')
    missing=[];invalid=[];checks={}
    for key,item in evidence.items():
        if key!=item.evidence_id:
            invalid.append(key);continue
        checks[key]=item.verify()
        if not checks[key]['valid']:invalid.append(key)
    for revision in ledger.revisions:
        for reference in revision.evidence:
            if reference not in evidence:missing.append({'revision_id':revision.revision_id,'evidence_id':reference})
    return {'valid':not missing and not invalid,'missing':missing,'invalid':invalid,'evidence_checks':checks,
            'scientific_truth_established':False,
            'scope':'reference integrity and supported replay; evidence-to-prose entailment and provenance require review'}

"""Immutable preregistration contracts; declarations do not authenticate people."""
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ReplicationProtocol:
    claim_revision: str
    owner: str
    authors: tuple[str, ...]
    metric: str
    minimum: float
    maximum: float
    evidence_ids: tuple[str, ...]
    procedure: str
    schema_version: int = 1

    def __post_init__(self):
        import math
        object.__setattr__(self, 'authors', tuple(self.authors))
        object.__setattr__(self, 'evidence_ids', tuple(self.evidence_ids))
        if type(self.schema_version) is not int or self.schema_version != 1 or any(not isinstance(x, str) or not x.strip() for x in
                (self.claim_revision, self.owner, self.metric, self.procedure, *self.authors, *self.evidence_ids)):
            raise ValueError('Versioned protocol requires nonempty declarations')
        if not 1 <= len(self.authors) <= 1000 or not 1 <= len(self.evidence_ids) <= 10000 or len(set(self.authors)) != len(self.authors) or len(set(self.evidence_ids)) != len(self.evidence_ids):
            raise ValueError('Authors and evidence required')
        if any(type(x) not in (float, int) or not math.isfinite(x) for x in (self.minimum, self.maximum)) or self.minimum > self.maximum:
            raise ValueError('Finite ordered acceptance interval required')

    @property
    def protocol_id(self):
        return fingerprint(asdict(self))

    def to_data(self):
        return {**asdict(self), 'protocol_id': self.protocol_id}

    @classmethod
    def from_data(cls, data):
        row = dict(data)
        identifier = row.pop('protocol_id')
        protocol = cls(**row)
        if identifier != protocol.protocol_id:
            raise ValueError('Protocol altered')
        return protocol

"""Declared retractions propagate review alerts, without rewriting historic claims."""
from .lineage import LineageGraph

def retraction_impact(graph: LineageGraph, retractions: list) -> dict:
    if not isinstance(graph, LineageGraph) or not isinstance(retractions, list) or len(retractions) > 1024:
        raise ValueError("Bounded graph and retraction records required")
    canonical_payload(retractions)
    known = {row["id"] for row in graph.to_data()["nodes"]}
    receipts, alerts = {}, {}
    for row in retractions:
        require_fields(row, {"target_id", "issuer", "reason", "evidence_id"})
        target = require_digest(row["target_id"])
        require_digest(row["evidence_id"])
        require_text(row["issuer"], "issuer", limit=256)
        require_text(row["reason"], "reason")
        if target not in known:
            raise ValueError("Retraction target absent from lineage")
        identifier = fingerprint(row)
        if identifier in receipts:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate retraction record")
        receipts[identifier] = dict(row)
        for node in (target, *graph.descendants(target)):
            alerts.setdefault(node, []).append(identifier)
    report = {"schema_version": 1, "lineage_id": graph.content_id,
              "retractions": [{"id": key, **receipts[key]} for key in sorted(receipts)],
              "alerts": [{"node_id": key, "requires_review": True, "retraction_ids": sorted(alerts[key])}
                         for key in sorted(alerts)], "historic_content_modified": False,
              "scope": "declared retractions and dependencies; issuer authenticity and scientific truth not established"}
    return {**report, "report_id": fingerprint(report)}


def verify_retraction_impact(report, graph, retractions):
    try:
        return canonical_payload(report) == canonical_payload(retraction_impact(graph, retractions))
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError):
        return False

"""Durable revocation watches backed by signed request/response evidence.

A watch authenticates a configured source's observation and the author's signed
revocation. It does not certify operator independence, scientific truth, trusted
time, or that every revocation on the Internet has been found. Accepted revocations
are never automatically undone when a source disappears or returns an older root.
"""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
from contextlib import contextmanager

from ..core.semantic_contracts import canonical_payload, require_fields, require_text
from ..core.semantic_ir import fingerprint
from ..network.signatures import MessageVerifier
from ..network.merkle_inventory import validate_manifest

REQUEST_AUDIENCE = 'Nabla-federation-request-v1'
RESPONSE_PREFIX = 'Nabla-federation-response-v1:'


def validate_signed_exchange(exchange, trust, *, client_peer, server_peer, now_unix):
    """Verify current keys, domain, freshness, request hash and response operation."""
    canonical_payload(exchange)
    require_fields(exchange, {'schema_version', 'request', 'response'})
    if type(exchange['schema_version']) is not int or exchange['schema_version'] != 1:
        raise ValueError('Unsupported signed exchange evidence')
    request, response = exchange['request'], exchange['response']
    authenticated_request = MessageVerifier(trust, REQUEST_AUDIENCE).verify(request, now_unix=now_unix)
    authenticated_response = MessageVerifier(trust, RESPONSE_PREFIX + fingerprint({'peer': client_peer})).verify(response, now_unix=now_unix)
    if (not authenticated_request['valid'] or authenticated_request.get('peer_id') != client_peer
            or not authenticated_response['valid'] or authenticated_response.get('peer_id') != server_peer):
        raise ValueError('Untrusted signed exchange identity or freshness')
    payload = authenticated_request['payload']
    body = authenticated_response['payload']
    require_fields(body, {'schema_version', 'request_id', 'operation', 'result', 'scope'})
    if (type(body['schema_version']) is not int or body['schema_version'] != 1
            or type(payload) is not dict or body['request_id'] != fingerprint(request)
            or body['operation'] != payload.get('operation')
            or response['issued_unix'] < request['issued_unix']
            or response['expires_unix'] > request['expires_unix']):
        raise ValueError('Signed exchange request/response binding mismatch')
    return payload, body['result']


class RevocationMonitor:
    """Bounded durable audit with monotonic source inventory observations.

    Database paths, configured identities and trust anchors are local operator
    configuration. Audit hashes detect accidental changes when the expected head
    is independently retained; they do not protect against a fully rewriting DBA.
    """
    def __init__(self, path, trust, *, client_peer, max_observations=10000,
                 max_sources=1000, max_evidence_bytes=64 * 1024 * 1024):
        require_text(client_peer, 'local peer', limit=200)
        for value, maximum in ((max_observations, 1000000), (max_sources, 10000),
                               (max_evidence_bytes, 1024 * 1024 * 1024)):
            if type(value) is not int or not 1 <= value <= maximum:
                raise ValueError('Invalid revocation-watch storage budget')
        self.path = Path(path)
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.trust = trust
        self.client_peer = client_peer
        self.max_observations = max_observations
        self.max_sources = max_sources
        self.max_evidence_bytes = max_evidence_bytes
        with self._transaction() as connection:
            connection.executescript('''
              CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS watch_sources(
                peer TEXT PRIMARY KEY, count INTEGER NOT NULL, root TEXT NOT NULL,
                last_issued INTEGER NOT NULL, last_observed INTEGER NOT NULL);
              CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS watch_observations(
                sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                source TEXT NOT NULL, operator TEXT NOT NULL, artifact TEXT NOT NULL,
                event_id TEXT NOT NULL, public_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                observed INTEGER NOT NULL, evidence TEXT NOT NULL,
                evidence_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, previous TEXT, receipt TEXT NOT NULL);
              CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS watch_artifact ON watch_observations(artifact,operator);
            ''')

    @contextmanager
    def _transaction(self):
        connection = sqlite3.connect(self.path, timeout=5, isolation_level=None)
        connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        try:
            connection.execute('PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000')
            connection.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
            yield connection
            if connection.in_transaction:
                connection.execute('COMMIT')
        except BaseException:
            if connection.in_transaction:
                connection.execute('ROLLBACK')
            raise
        finally:
            connection.close()

    def observe(self, manifest_exchange, revocation_exchange, *, source_peer, now_unix):
        """Record one authenticated revocation without trusting caller-only metadata."""
        from services.federation.inventory import verify_revocation_proof

            raise ValueError('Explicit observation clock required')
        manifest_request, manifest = validate_signed_exchange(manifest_exchange, self.trust,
            client_peer=self.client_peer, server_peer=source_peer, now_unix=now_unix)
        revocation_request, proof = validate_signed_exchange(revocation_exchange, self.trust,
            client_peer=self.client_peer, server_peer=source_peer, now_unix=now_unix)
        validate_manifest(manifest)
        if (manifest_request.get('operation') != 'manifest'
                or manifest_request.get('snapshot_id') != manifest['snapshot_id']
                or revocation_request.get('operation') != 'revocation'
                or revocation_request.get('snapshot_id') != manifest['snapshot_id']):
            raise ValueError('Watch evidence does not refer to one authenticated snapshot')
        report = verify_revocation_proof(proof, self.trust, expected_manifest=manifest)
        if report['revocation_event_id'] != revocation_request.get('event_id'):
            raise ValueError('Revocation proof does not match signed request')
        source_issued = max(manifest_exchange['response']['issued_unix'], revocation_exchange['response']['issued_unix'])
        evidence = {'manifest_exchange': manifest_exchange, 'revocation_exchange': revocation_exchange}
        encoded = canonical_payload(evidence)
        evidence_id = fingerprint(evidence)
        key = proof['chain'][-1]['event']['public_key']
        with self._transaction() as connection:
            last = connection.execute('SELECT * FROM watch_observations ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1').fetchone()
            if last and now_unix < last['observed']:
                raise ValueError('Persistent watch clock rollback')
            source = connection.execute('SELECT * FROM watch_sources WHERE peer=?', (source_peer,)).fetchone()
            if source:
                if manifest['count'] < source['count'] or source_issued < source['last_issued']:
                    raise ValueError('Source observation rollback')
                if manifest['count'] == source['count'] and manifest['root'] != source['root']:
                    raise ValueError('Source equivocated at the same inventory size')
            elif connection.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM watch_sources').fetchone()[0] >= self.max_sources:
                raise ValueError('Watch source capacity exhausted')
            existing = connection.execute('SELECT receipt FROM watch_observations WHERE id=?', (evidence_id,)).fetchone()
            if existing:
                return json.loads(existing['receipt'])
            count, used = connection.execute('SELECT count(*),coalesce(sum(evidence_bytes),0) FROM watch_observations').fetchone()
            if count >= self.max_observations or used + len(encoded.encode()) > self.max_evidence_bytes:
                raise ValueError('Durable revocation evidence capacity exhausted')
            previous = None if last is None else fingerprint(json.loads(last['receipt']))
            body = {'schema_version': 1, 'evidence_id': evidence_id, 'source_peer': source_peer,
                    'operator': report['operator'], 'artifact': report['artifact'],
                    'revocation_event_id': report['revocation_event_id'],
                    'snapshot_id': manifest['snapshot_id'], 'observed_unix': now_unix,
                    'previous_receipt': previous, 'trusted_timestamp_established': False}
            receipt = {**body, 'receipt_id': fingerprint(body)}
            connection.execute('INSERT INTO watch_observations(id,source,operator,artifact,event_id,public_key,observed,evidence,evidence_bytes,previous,receipt) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
                (evidence_id, source_peer, report['operator'], report['artifact'], report['revocation_event_id'],
                 key, now_unix, encoded, len(encoded.encode()), previous, canonical_payload(receipt)))
            connection.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO watch_sources VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',
                (source_peer, manifest['count'], manifest['root'], source_issued, now_unix))

    def status(self, artifact):
        from ..core.semantic_contracts import require_digest
        require_digest(artifact)

            rows = connection.execute('SELECT operator,event_id,source,public_key,observed FROM watch_observations WHERE artifact=? ORDER BY sequence',
                                      (artifact,)).fetchall()

                    'author_key_currently_trusted': self.trust.accepts(r['operator'], r['public_key'])} for r in rows],
                'scope': 'known authenticated operator revocations; no global completeness guarantee'}

    def audit(self, *, expected_head=None):
        """Replay stored evidence and receipt hashes without renewing old freshness.

        Historical signature validation uses each exchange's original observation
        time. Current pinned-key revocation is still enforced and may invalidate
        the authentication of older evidence; the conservative revoked flag stays.
        """
        with self._transaction() as connection:

            if (receipt.get('receipt_id') != fingerprint(body) or receipt.get('previous_receipt') != previous

            manifest_request, manifest = validate_signed_exchange(evidence['manifest_exchange'], self.trust,
                client_peer=self.client_peer, server_peer=row['source'], now_unix=row['observed'])
            revocation_request, proof = validate_signed_exchange(evidence['revocation_exchange'], self.trust,
                client_peer=self.client_peer, server_peer=row['source'], now_unix=row['observed'])

            result = verify_revocation_proof(proof, self.trust, expected_manifest=manifest)
            if (result['revocation_event_id'] != row['event_id'] or result['operator'] != row['operator']
                    or result['artifact'] != row['artifact']
                    or proof['chain'][-1]['event']['public_key'] != row['public_key']
                    or receipt.get('snapshot_id') != manifest['snapshot_id']
                    or receipt.get('source_peer') != row['source']
                    or receipt.get('operator') != row['operator'] or receipt.get('artifact') != row['artifact']
                    or receipt.get('revocation_event_id') != row['event_id']
                    or receipt.get('observed_unix') != row['observed']
                    or manifest_request.get('operation') != 'manifest'
                    or revocation_request.get('operation') != 'revocation'
                    or revocation_request.get('event_id') != row['event_id']
                    or manifest_request.get('snapshot_id') != manifest['snapshot_id']
                    or revocation_request.get('snapshot_id') != manifest['snapshot_id']):

            if row['observed'] < last_observed:

            if earlier and (manifest['count'] < earlier['count'] or issued < earlier['last_issued']
                    or (manifest['count'] == earlier['count'] and manifest['root'] != earlier['root'])):
                raise ValueError('Revocation audit source rollback or equivocation')
            reconstructed_sources[row['source']] = {'peer': row['source'], 'count': manifest['count'],
                'root': manifest['root'], 'last_issued': issued, 'last_observed': row['observed']}

            raise ValueError('Revocation watch source cache corrupted')

            raise ValueError('Revocation audit external head mismatch')

"""Conservative semantic keys; equivalence proposals do not merge histories."""
import unicodedata
from ..core.semantic_ir import fingerprint
from ..expression import parse_expr,render
from ..math.algebra.groebner import polynomial_from_expr


def semantic_key(revision,metadata=None):
    if metadata is None:
        return fingerprint({'kind':'exact_text','statement':unicodedata.normalize('NFC',revision.statement)})
    if set(metadata)!={'kind','expression','domain','input_unit','output_unit','assumptions'} or metadata['kind']!='polynomial':
        raise ValueError('Metadados semânticos desconhecidos')
    if render(parse_expr(metadata['expression']))!=render(parse_expr(revision.statement)):
        raise ValueError('Expressão não corresponde ao enunciado da revisão')
    polynomial=polynomial_from_expr(parse_expr(metadata['expression']),('x',))
    from ..core.semantic_ir import rational
    if len(metadata['domain'])!=2 or rational(metadata['domain'][0])>=rational(metadata['domain'][1]):
        raise ValueError('Domínio semântico inválido')
    from ..core.obligations import domain_obligations
    data={**metadata,'domain_obligations':[o.to_data() for o in domain_obligations(parse_expr(metadata['expression']))],'expression':[[list(m),str(c)] for m,c in polynomial.terms],
          'domain':[str(rational(v)) for v in metadata['domain']]}
    return fingerprint(data)


def reconcile(ledgers,*,metadata=None):
    metadata=metadata or {};groups={};heads={}
    for ledger in ledgers:
        for claim in sorted({r.claim for r in ledger.revisions}):
            revision=ledger.latest(claim)
            key=semantic_key(revision,metadata.get(revision.revision_id))
            groups.setdefault(key,set()).add(revision.revision_id)
            heads.setdefault(claim,set()).add(revision.revision_id)
    revisions={r.revision_id:r for ledger in ledgers for r in ledger.revisions}
    for claim,values in heads.items():
        ancestors=set()
        for identifier in values:
            current=revisions[identifier].previous
            while current is not None:
                ancestors.add(current);current=revisions[current].previous
        heads[claim]=values-ancestors
    return {'equivalence_proposals':[{'semantic_id':key,'revisions':sorted(values)} for key,values in sorted(groups.items()) if len(values)>1],
            'concurrent_heads':{key:sorted(values) for key,values in heads.items() if len(values)>1},
            'automatic_merge_performed':False,'scope':'exact text or declared polynomial domains/units/assumptions only'}

"""Durable content-addressed signed snapshot exchange, quarantine and delta inventory."""
from contextlib import closing
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
from ..core.semantic_ir import canonical_json,fingerprint
from .identity import PeerTrust,PeerKey,verify_signed_snapshot
from .federation import SignedFederation


class SnapshotStore:
    def __init__(self,path):
        self.path=Path(path);self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path)) as db,db:
            db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS snapshots (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, envelope TEXT NOT NULL)')
            db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quarantine (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, reason TEXT NOT NULL)')
            db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trust (peer TEXT NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL, revoked INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(peer,key))')

    def trust(self):
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path)) as db:
            rows=db.execute('SELECT peer,key,revoked FROM trust ORDER BY peer,key').fetchall()
        return PeerTrust(PeerKey(peer,key,bool(revoked)) for peer,key,revoked in rows)

    def pin(self,key):
        trust=self.trust();trust.pin(key)
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path)) as db,db:
            db.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
            existing=db.execute('SELECT revoked FROM trust WHERE peer=? AND key=?',(key.peer_id,key.public_key)).fetchone()
            if existing and existing[0] and not key.revoked:raise ValueError('Chave revogada')
            db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO trust VALUES (?,?,?)',(key.peer_id,key.public_key,int(key.revoked)))

    def ingest(self,envelope):
        raw=canonical_json(envelope)
        if len(raw.encode())>32*1024*1024:raise ValueError('Envelope excede limite')
        identifier=fingerprint(envelope)
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path)) as db,db:
            db.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
            trust=PeerTrust(PeerKey(peer,key,bool(revoked)) for peer,key,revoked in db.execute('SELECT peer,key,revoked FROM trust'))
            verification=verify_signed_snapshot(envelope,trust)
            if verification['valid']:
                db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO snapshots VALUES (?,?)',(identifier,raw))
            else:
                db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO quarantine VALUES (?,?)',(identifier,verification.get('reason','invalid evidence')))
        return {**verification,'envelope_id':identifier,'quarantined':not verification['valid']}

    def inventory(self):
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path)) as db:
            return tuple(row[0] for row in db.execute('SELECT id FROM snapshots ORDER BY id'))

    def delta(self,known=(),*,limit=100):
        known=set(known)
        if len(known)>10000 or type(limit) is not int or not 1<=limit<=100:raise ValueError('Orçamento de sincronização inválido')
        trust=self.trust();result=[]
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path)) as db:
            for identifier,raw in db.execute('SELECT id,envelope FROM snapshots ORDER BY id'):
                if identifier in known:continue
                envelope=json.loads(raw)
                if fingerprint(envelope)!=identifier or not verify_signed_snapshot(envelope,trust)['valid']:
                    raise ValueError('Snapshot persistido alterado ou confiança revogada')
                result.append(envelope)
                if len(result)==limit:break
        return result

    def reconcile(self,*,metadata=None):
        federation=SignedFederation(self.trust())
        known=set()
        while True:
            page=self.delta(known)
            if not page:break
            for envelope in page:
                known.add(fingerprint(envelope));federation.ingest(envelope)
        return federation.reconcile(metadata=metadata)

    def quarantined(self):
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path)) as db:
            return tuple({'envelope_id':i,'reason':r} for i,r in db.execute('SELECT id,reason FROM quarantine ORDER BY id'))

class ClaimLedger:
    def __init__(self, revisions=()):
        self._revisions = {}
        self._latest = {}
        for revision in revisions:
            self.append(revision)

    def get(self, revision_id):
        return self._revisions[revision_id]

    def to_data(self):
        return {'schema_version':1,'revisions':[r.to_data() for r in self.revisions]}

    @classmethod
    def from_data(cls,data):
        if set(data)!={'schema_version','revisions'} or data['schema_version']!=1 or len(data['revisions'])>10000:
            raise ValueError('Contrato de histórico inválido')
        ledger=cls()
        for item in data['revisions']:
            row=dict(item);identifier=row.pop('revision_id')
            revision=ClaimRevision(**row)
            if revision.revision_id!=identifier:
                raise ValueError('Hash de revisão divergente')
            ledger.append(revision)
        return ledger

    @property
    def revisions(self):
        return tuple(self._revisions.values())

    def latest(self, claim: str) -> ClaimRevision:
        return self._revisions[self._latest[claim]]

    def append(self, revision: ClaimRevision) -> str:
        if revision.revision_id in self._revisions:
            raise ValueError('Revisao duplicada')
        if revision.previous != self._latest.get(revision.claim):
            raise ValueError('Revisao anterior ausente ou desatualizada')
        for dependency in revision.dependencies:
            if dependency not in self._revisions:
                raise ValueError('Dependencia ausente')
        self._revisions[revision.revision_id] = revision
        self._latest[revision.claim] = revision.revision_id
        return revision.revision_id

    def affected_by(self, revision_id: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        if revision_id not in self._revisions:
            raise KeyError(revision_id)
        affected = {revision_id}
        # Append order is already topological; dependencies are immutable IDs.
        for identifier, revision in self._revisions.items():
            if revision.previous in affected or any(d in affected for d in revision.dependencies):
                affected.add(identifier)
        return tuple(sorted(affected - {revision_id}))

    def save(self, path: Path) -> None:
        """Exclusive creation preserves any existing user ledger."""
        with Path(path).open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
            for revision in self.revisions:
                stream.write(canonical_json(revision.to_data()) + '\n')

    @classmethod
    def load(cls, path: Path):
        if Path(path).stat().st_size > 16*1024*1024:
            raise ValueError('Historico excede o limite')
        ledger = cls()
        for line in Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
            row = json.loads(line)
            identifier = row.pop('revision_id')
            row['evidence'] = tuple(row['evidence'])
            row['dependencies'] = tuple(row['dependencies'])
            revision = ClaimRevision(**row)
            if revision.revision_id != identifier:
                raise ValueError('Hash de revisao divergente')
            ledger.append(revision)
        return ledger

"""Bounded structured expressions shared by optional advanced algorithms.

Never pass request text to sympify/parse_expr/lambdify. Algorithms may be costly;
remote callers must use AgentTools' process budget, not call these APIs in-process.
"""
import ast
from fractions import Fraction
import math


def sympy():
    try:
        import sympy as sp
    except ImportError as error:
        raise ImportError('Install nablamath[research] for symbolic advanced mathematics') from error
    return sp


def names(variables, maximum=16):
    if not isinstance(variables, (list, tuple)) or not 1 <= len(variables) <= maximum:
        raise ValueError('Invalid variable dimension')
    if any(type(v) is not str or not v.isidentifier() or v.startswith('_') for v in variables) or len(set(variables)) != len(variables):
        raise ValueError('Distinct public variable identifiers required')
    return tuple(variables)


def expression(source, variables, *, functions=True, degree_limit=128):
    sp = sympy(); variables = names(variables,32)
    symbols = {v: sp.Symbol(v) for v in variables}
    if type(source) not in (str, int, float, Fraction):
        raise ValueError('Expression must be a scalar or a source string')
    source = str(source)
    if len(source) > 8192:
        raise ValueError('Expression source budget exceeded')
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(source, mode='eval')
    except (SyntaxError, RecursionError) as error:
        raise ValueError('Invalid expression syntax') from error
    if sum(1 for _ in ast.walk(tree)) > 1024:
        raise ValueError('Expression AST budget exceeded')
    def degree_budget(node,depth=0):
        if depth>48:raise ValueError('Expression depth budget exceeded')
        if isinstance(node,ast.Name):return (1,0) if node.id in variables else (0,0)
        if isinstance(node,ast.UnaryOp):return degree_budget(node.operand,depth+1)
        if isinstance(node,ast.Call):
            for arg in node.args:degree_budget(arg,depth+1)
            return (0,0)
        if not isinstance(node,ast.BinOp):return (0,0)
        an,ad=degree_budget(node.left,depth+1);bn,bd=degree_budget(node.right,depth+1)
        if isinstance(node.op,(ast.Add,ast.Sub)):value=max(an+bd,bn+ad),ad+bd
        elif isinstance(node.op,ast.Mult):value=an+bn,ad+bd
        elif isinstance(node.op,ast.Div):value=an+bd,ad+bn
        elif isinstance(node.op,ast.Pow):
            try:power=ast.literal_eval(node.right)
            except (ValueError,TypeError):return (0,0)
            if type(power) is not int:return (0,0)
            value=(an*power,ad*power) if power>=0 else (-ad*power,-an*power)
        else:return (0,0)
        if max(value)>degree_limit:raise ValueError('Symbolic degree budget exceeded before polynomial expansion')
        active=len({v.id for v in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(v,ast.Name) and v.id in variables})
        if active and math.comb(max(value)+active,active)>100000:raise ValueError('Symbolic expansion term budget exceeded before CAS expansion')
        return value
    degree_budget(tree.body)
    allowed = {key: getattr(sp, key) for key in ('sin','cos','tan','exp','log','sqrt','sinh','cosh','tanh','Abs','erf')}
    def bounded(value):
        if value.is_Rational and max(int(value.p).bit_length(),int(value.q).bit_length())>16384:
            raise ValueError('Expression rational arithmetic budget exceeded')
        return value
    def visit(node, depth=0):
        if depth > 48:
            raise ValueError('Expression depth budget exceeded')
        if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and type(node.value) in (int, float):
            if isinstance(node.value, float) and not math.isfinite(node.value):
                raise ValueError('Nonfinite scalar')
            if isinstance(node.value, int) and node.value.bit_length() > 4096:
                raise ValueError('Integer input budget exceeded')
            return sp.Rational(str(node.value))
        if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
            if node.id in symbols: return symbols[node.id]
            if node.id in ('pi', 'I'): return sp.pi if node.id == 'pi' else sp.I
        if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp) and isinstance(node.op, (ast.UAdd, ast.USub)):
            value = visit(node.operand, depth+1)
            return -value if isinstance(node.op, ast.USub) else value
        if isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):
            a, b = visit(node.left, depth+1), visit(node.right, depth+1)
            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Add): return bounded(a+b)
            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Sub): return bounded(a-b)
            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Mult): return bounded(a*b)
            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Div):
                if b == 0: raise ValueError('Division by zero')
                return bounded(a/b)
            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Pow) and b.is_Rational and abs(b) <= 32:
                if a.is_Rational and b.is_Integer and abs(b)*(max(int(a.p).bit_length(),int(a.q).bit_length()))>16384:
                    raise ValueError('Expression power arithmetic budget exceeded')
                return bounded(a**b)
        if functions and isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id in allowed and not node.keywords and len(node.args) == 1:
            return allowed[node.func.id](visit(node.args[0], depth+1))
        raise ValueError('Unsupported expression node')
    return visit(tree.body), tuple(symbols.values())


def rational_matrix(rows, *, maximum=64):
    sp = sympy()
    if not isinstance(rows, (list, tuple)) or not 1 <= len(rows) <= maximum or any(not isinstance(r,(list,tuple)) or not 1 <= len(r) <= maximum for r in rows):
        raise ValueError('Matrix dimension budget exceeded')
    if len({len(row) for row in rows}) != 1: raise ValueError('Ragged matrix')
    from ..ops._area_utils import scalar
    return sp.Matrix([[sp.Rational(str(scalar(v))) for v in row] for row in rows])


def data(value):
    """Portable output: exact symbolic values are strings, never executable code."""
    if isinstance(value, dict): return {str(k): data(v) for k,v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (tuple,list)): return [data(v) for v in value]
    if value is None or type(value) in (str,int,bool,float): return value
    if isinstance(value, Fraction): return str(value)
    if hasattr(value, 'tolist'): return data(value.tolist())
    return str(value)


def numeric_array(values, *, ndim=None, maximum=100000):
    try: import numpy as np
    except ImportError as error: raise ImportError('Install nablamath[scipy]') from error
    a = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    if a.size > maximum or (ndim is not None and a.ndim != ndim) or not np.isfinite(a).all():
        raise ValueError('Invalid finite numerical array')
    return a


def domain_conditions(source,variables):
    """Retain syntactic partial-domain guards even if CAS simplification cancels."""
    expression(source,variables)
    tree=ast.parse(str(source),mode='eval');conditions=[]
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node,ast.BinOp) and isinstance(node.op,ast.Div):conditions.append(ast.unparse(node.right)+' != 0')
        if isinstance(node,ast.BinOp) and isinstance(node.op,ast.Pow) and isinstance(node.right,ast.UnaryOp) and isinstance(node.right.op,ast.USub):conditions.append(ast.unparse(node.left)+' != 0')
        if isinstance(node,ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func,ast.Name) and node.func.id in {'log','sqrt'}:
            conditions.append(ast.unparse(node.args[0])+(' > 0 (real branch)' if node.func.id=='log' else ' >= 0 (real branch)'))
    return sorted(set(conditions))

"""Exact simple algebraic extensions ``Q(α)=Q[x]/(m(x))`` for degree 2/3."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from fractions import Fraction
from math import gcd
from math import isqrt
from typing import Iterable

Coefficients = tuple[Fraction, ...]  # low degree first


def _trim(values: Iterable[Fraction | int]) -> Coefficients:
    result = [Fraction(value) for value in values]
    while result and result[-1] == 0:
        result.pop()
    return tuple(result)


def _add(first: Coefficients, second: Coefficients) -> Coefficients:
    size = max(len(first), len(second))
    return _trim((first[index] if index < len(first) else 0)
                 + (second[index] if index < len(second) else 0) for index in range(size))


def _neg(values: Coefficients) -> Coefficients:
    return tuple(-value for value in values)


def _mul(first: Coefficients, second: Coefficients) -> Coefficients:
    if not first or not second:
        return ()
    result = [Fraction(0)] * (len(first) + len(second) - 1)
    for left_degree, left in enumerate(first):
        for right_degree, right in enumerate(second):
            result[left_degree + right_degree] += left * right
    return _trim(result)


def _divmod(dividend: Coefficients, divisor: Coefficients) -> tuple[Coefficients, Coefficients]:
    if not divisor:
        raise ZeroDivisionError("Polinômio divisor zero")
    remainder = list(dividend)
    quotient = [Fraction(0)] * max(0, len(dividend) - len(divisor) + 1)
    while len(remainder) >= len(divisor) and remainder:
        degree = len(remainder) - len(divisor)
        factor = remainder[-1] / divisor[-1]
        quotient[degree] += factor
        for index, coefficient in enumerate(divisor):
            remainder[degree + index] -= factor * coefficient
        remainder = list(_trim(remainder))
    return _trim(quotient), _trim(remainder)


def _xgcd(first: Coefficients, second: Coefficients) -> tuple[Coefficients, Coefficients, Coefficients]:
    old_r, r = first, second
    old_s, s = (Fraction(1),), ()
    old_t, t = (), (Fraction(1),)
    while r:
        quotient, remainder = _divmod(old_r, r)
        old_r, r = r, remainder
        old_s, s = s, _add(old_s, _neg(_mul(quotient, s)))
        old_t, t = t, _add(old_t, _neg(_mul(quotient, t)))
    if old_r:
        scale = old_r[-1]
        old_r = tuple(value / scale for value in old_r)
        old_s = tuple(value / scale for value in old_s)
        old_t = tuple(value / scale for value in old_t)
    return old_r, old_s, old_t


def _integer_polynomial(values: Coefficients) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    common = 1
    for value in values:
        common = common * value.denominator // gcd(common, value.denominator)
    integers = tuple(int(value * common) for value in values)
    common_gcd = 0
    for value in integers:
        common_gcd = gcd(common_gcd, abs(value))
    return tuple(value // max(1, common_gcd) for value in integers)


def _has_rational_root(values: Coefficients) -> bool:
    integers = _integer_polynomial(values)
    if max(abs(v) for v in integers)>100000:
        from .._structured import sympy
        sp=sympy();x=sp.Symbol('x')
        return not sp.Poly(sum(int(v)*x**i for i,v in enumerate(integers)),x,domain=sp.QQ).is_irreducible
    constant, leading = integers[0], integers[-1]
    if constant == 0:
        return True
    numerators = [value for value in range(1, abs(constant) + 1) if constant % value == 0]
    denominators = [value for value in range(1, abs(leading) + 1) if leading % value == 0]
    for numerator in numerators:
        for denominator in denominators:
            for sign in (-1, 1):
                root = Fraction(sign * numerator, denominator)
                if sum(coefficient * root**degree for degree, coefficient in enumerate(values)) == 0:
                    return True
    return False


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AlgebraicField:
    minimal_polynomial: Coefficients
    symbol: str = "α"

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        polynomial = _trim(self.minimal_polynomial)
        degree = len(polynomial) - 1
        if not 2 <= degree <= 16:
            raise ValueError("Extension degree must be between two and sixteen")
        if polynomial[-1] != 1:
            polynomial = tuple(value / polynomial[-1] for value in polynomial)
        if any(max(v.numerator.bit_length(),v.denominator.bit_length())>4096 for v in polynomial):
            raise ValueError('Algebraic coefficient input budget exceeded')
        if degree == 2:
            discriminant=polynomial[1]**2-4*polynomial[0]*polynomial[2]
            reducible=(discriminant>=0 and isqrt(discriminant.numerator)**2==discriminant.numerator and isqrt(discriminant.denominator)**2==discriminant.denominator)
        elif degree == 3:
            reducible = _has_rational_root(polynomial)
        else:
            from .._structured import sympy
            sp=sympy();x=sp.Symbol('x')
            reducible = not sp.Poly(sum(sp.Rational(str(v))*x**i for i,v in enumerate(polynomial)),x,domain=sp.QQ).is_irreducible
        if reducible:raise ValueError("Polinômio não é irredutível sobre Q")
        object.__setattr__(self, "minimal_polynomial", polynomial)

    @property
    def degree(self) -> int:
        return len(self.minimal_polynomial) - 1

    def element(self, coefficients: Iterable[Fraction | int]) -> AlgebraicNumber:
        _, reduced = _divmod(_trim(coefficients), self.minimal_polynomial)
        return AlgebraicNumber(self, reduced + (Fraction(0),) * (self.degree - len(reduced)))

    @property
    def alpha(self) -> AlgebraicNumber:
        return self.element((0, 1))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AlgebraicNumber:
    field: AlgebraicField
    coefficients: Coefficients

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if len(self.coefficients) != self.field.degree:
            raise ValueError("Representante fora da dimensão da extensão")
        if any(max(Fraction(v).numerator.bit_length(),Fraction(v).denominator.bit_length())>65536 for v in self.coefficients):
            raise ValueError('Algebraic element arithmetic budget exceeded')

    def _coerce(self, other: AlgebraicNumber | Fraction | int) -> AlgebraicNumber:
        if isinstance(other, AlgebraicNumber):
            if other.field != self.field:
                raise ValueError("Elementos pertencem a extensões diferentes")
            return other
        return self.field.element((Fraction(other),))

    def __add__(self, other: AlgebraicNumber | Fraction | int) -> AlgebraicNumber:
        right = self._coerce(other)
        return self.field.element(_add(self.coefficients, right.coefficients))

    __radd__ = __add__

    def __neg__(self) -> AlgebraicNumber:
        return self.field.element(_neg(self.coefficients))

    def __sub__(self, other: AlgebraicNumber | Fraction | int) -> AlgebraicNumber:
        return self + -self._coerce(other)

    def __mul__(self, other: AlgebraicNumber | Fraction | int) -> AlgebraicNumber:
        right = self._coerce(other)
        return self.field.element(_mul(self.coefficients, right.coefficients))

    __rmul__ = __mul__

    def inverse(self) -> AlgebraicNumber:
        if not any(self.coefficients):
            raise ZeroDivisionError("Zero não possui inverso")
        gcd_polynomial, coefficient, _ = _xgcd(_trim(self.coefficients), self.field.minimal_polynomial)
        if gcd_polynomial != (Fraction(1),):
            raise ArithmeticError("Elemento não invertível; extensão inconsistente")
        return self.field.element(coefficient)

    def __truediv__(self, other: AlgebraicNumber | Fraction | int) -> AlgebraicNumber:
        return self * self._coerce(other).inverse()

    def __pow__(self, exponent: int) -> AlgebraicNumber:
        if type(exponent) is not int or abs(exponent)>10000:
            raise ValueError("Expoente deve ser inteiro entre -10000 e 10000")
        if exponent < 0:
            return self.inverse() ** -exponent
        result, factor = self.field.element((1,)), self
        while exponent:
            if exponent & 1:
                result = result * factor
            factor = factor * factor
            exponent //= 2
        return result


__all__ = ["AlgebraicField", "AlgebraicNumber", "Coefficients"]


def number_field(radicals,polynomial=None,variable='x'):
    """Construct the primitive element of a supplied tower of algebraic generators."""
    from .._structured import expression,sympy,data
    sp=sympy()
    if not isinstance(radicals,list) or not 1<=len(radicals)<=8:raise ValueError('Require 1–8 algebraic generators')
    values=[]
    for raw in radicals:
        value,_=expression(raw,[variable])
        if value.free_symbols or value.is_algebraic is not True:raise ValueError('Constant algebraic generators required')
        values.append(value)
    primitive=sp.polys.numberfields.to_number_field(values)
    result={'primitive_element':str(primitive.as_expr()),'minimal_polynomial':str(primitive.minpoly.as_expr()),
            'degree':primitive.minpoly.degree(),'generator_coordinates':[data(sp.polys.numberfields.to_number_field(v,primitive).coeffs()) for v in values]}
    if result['degree']>64:raise ValueError('Primitive extension degree budget exceeded')
    if polynomial is not None:
        p,(x,)=expression(polynomial,[variable],functions=False)
        coefficient,factors=sp.factor_list(p,x,extension=values)
        result['factorization']={'coefficient':str(coefficient),'factors':[[str(f),m] for f,m in factors]}
    return result


def field_arithmetic(polynomial,left,*,right=None,operation='multiply',exponent=1):
    from ...ops._area_utils import vector
    field=AlgebraicField(tuple(vector(polynomial,maximum=17)));a=field.element(vector(left,maximum=64))
    if operation=='inverse':value=a.inverse()
    elif operation=='power':value=a**exponent
    else:
        if right is None:raise ValueError('Binary field operation requires right operand')
        b=field.element(vector(right,maximum=64))
        if operation=='add':value=a+b
        elif operation=='subtract':value=a-b
        elif operation=='multiply':value=a*b
        elif operation=='divide':value=a/b
        else:raise ValueError('Unknown field operation')
    return {'coefficients':list(map(str,value.coefficients)),'degree':field.degree,'arithmetic':'exact_Q_extension'}

"""Exact F4-style Gröbner basis computation over the rationals.

The implementation performs degree-batched critical-pair selection, symbolic
preprocessing into Macaulay matrices, exact Gaussian elimination and extraction
of new reducers.  It is a reference implementation, not the F4 paper's optimized
sparse data structure.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from fractions import Fraction
from itertools import combinations
from typing import Literal, Sequence

from .groebner import Monomial, MonomialOrder, Polynomial, divide_polynomial


def _key(monomial: Monomial, order: MonomialOrder) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    if order == "lex":
        return monomial
    if order == "grlex":
        return (sum(monomial), *monomial)
    return (sum(monomial), *(-value for value in reversed(monomial)))


def _divides(left: Monomial, right: Monomial) -> bool:
    return all(first <= second for first, second in zip(left, right))


def _quotient(left: Monomial, right: Monomial) -> Monomial:
    return tuple(first - second for first, second in zip(left, right))


def _lcm(left: Monomial, right: Monomial) -> Monomial:
    return tuple(max(first, second) for first, second in zip(left, right))


def _s_polynomial(first: Polynomial, second: Polynomial,
                  order: MonomialOrder) -> Polynomial:
    left_monomial, left_coefficient = first.leading_term(order)
    right_monomial, right_coefficient = second.leading_term(order)
    common = _lcm(left_monomial, right_monomial)
    return (first.multiply_term(_quotient(common, left_monomial), 1 / left_coefficient)
            - second.multiply_term(_quotient(common, right_monomial), 1 / right_coefficient))


def _rref(matrix: list[list[Fraction]]) -> tuple[list[list[Fraction]], tuple[int, ...]]:
    if not matrix:
        return [], ()
    pivot_row, pivots = 0, []
    for column in range(len(matrix[0])):
        candidate = next((row for row in range(pivot_row, len(matrix))
                          if matrix[row][column]), None)
        if candidate is None:
            continue
        matrix[pivot_row], matrix[candidate] = matrix[candidate], matrix[pivot_row]
        scale = matrix[pivot_row][column]
        matrix[pivot_row] = [value / scale for value in matrix[pivot_row]]
        for row in range(len(matrix)):
            if row != pivot_row and matrix[row][column]:
                factor = matrix[row][column]
                matrix[row] = [value - factor * pivot
                               for value, pivot in zip(matrix[row], matrix[pivot_row])]
        pivots.append(column)
        pivot_row += 1
        if pivot_row == len(matrix):
            break
    return matrix, tuple(pivots)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MacaulayMatrix:
    monomials: tuple[Monomial, ...]
    rows: tuple[tuple[Fraction, ...], ...]
    source_rows: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class F4Result:
    basis: tuple[Polynomial, ...]
    pair_batches: int
    matrices: int
    maximum_rows: int
    maximum_columns: int
    maximum_nonzeros: int


def _sparse_rref(rows: Sequence[Sequence[Fraction]]) -> tuple[list[dict[int, Fraction]], tuple[int, ...]]:
    """Exact sparse Gauss–Jordan elimination without materializing fill-in zeros."""
    sparse = [{column: value for column, value in enumerate(row) if value}
              for row in rows]
    pivots: list[int] = []
    pivot_row = 0
    columns = max((max(row, default=-1) for row in sparse), default=-1) + 1
    for column in range(columns):
        candidate = next((index for index in range(pivot_row, len(sparse))
                          if sparse[index].get(column)), None)
        if candidate is None:
            continue
        sparse[pivot_row], sparse[candidate] = sparse[candidate], sparse[pivot_row]
        scale = sparse[pivot_row][column]
        sparse[pivot_row] = {key: value / scale for key, value in sparse[pivot_row].items()}
        pivot = sparse[pivot_row]
        for index, row in enumerate(sparse):
            if index == pivot_row or not row.get(column):
                continue
            factor = row[column]
            keys = set(row) | set(pivot)
            reduced = {key: row.get(key, Fraction(0)) - factor * pivot.get(key, Fraction(0))
                       for key in keys}
            sparse[index] = {key: value for key, value in reduced.items() if value}
        pivots.append(column)
        pivot_row += 1
        if pivot_row == len(sparse):
            break
    return sparse, tuple(pivots)


def build_macaulay_matrix(sources: Sequence[Polynomial], basis: Sequence[Polynomial], *,
                          order: MonomialOrder = "grevlex",
                          row_limit: int = 100_000,
                          column_limit: int = 100_000) -> MacaulayMatrix:
    """Perform F4 symbolic preprocessing and build an exact sparse-to-dense matrix."""
    if not sources:
        return MacaulayMatrix((), (), 0)
    variables = sources[0].variables
    if any(polynomial.variables != variables for polynomial in (*sources, *basis)):
        raise ValueError("Polinômios pertencem a anéis diferentes")
    rows = list(sources)
    seen_rows = set(rows)
    processed_monomials: set[Monomial] = set()
    cursor = 0
    while cursor < len(rows):
        polynomial = rows[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        for monomial, _ in polynomial.terms:
            if monomial in processed_monomials:
                continue
            processed_monomials.add(monomial)
            reducer = next((candidate for candidate in basis
                            if _divides(candidate.leading_term(order)[0], monomial)), None)
            if reducer is None:
                continue
            leading, coefficient = reducer.leading_term(order)
            multiple = reducer.multiply_term(_quotient(monomial, leading), 1 / coefficient)
            if multiple not in seen_rows:
                if len(rows) >= row_limit:
                    raise RuntimeError("Pré-processamento F4 excedeu row_limit")
                rows.append(multiple)
                seen_rows.add(multiple)
    monomials = tuple(sorted({monomial for row in rows for monomial, _ in row.terms},
                             key=lambda item: _key(item, order), reverse=True))
    if len(monomials) > column_limit:
        raise RuntimeError("Matriz Macaulay excedeu column_limit")
    index = {monomial: column for column, monomial in enumerate(monomials)}
    dense = []
    for polynomial in rows:
        row = [Fraction(0)] * len(monomials)
        for monomial, coefficient in polynomial.terms:
            row[index[monomial]] = coefficient
        dense.append(tuple(row))
    return MacaulayMatrix(monomials, tuple(dense), len(sources))


def f4_basis(generators: Sequence[Polynomial], *, order: MonomialOrder = "grevlex",
             pair_limit: int = 100_000, row_limit: int = 100_000,
             column_limit: int = 100_000) -> F4Result:
    """Compute a Gröbner basis using F4 matrix batches and exact verification."""
    if not generators:
        return F4Result((), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    variables = generators[0].variables
    if any(item.variables != variables for item in generators):
        raise ValueError("Geradores pertencem a anéis diferentes")
    basis: list[Polynomial] = []
    for generator in generators:
        if generator.is_zero:
            continue
        _, remainder = divide_polynomial(generator, basis, order=order) if basis else ((), generator)
        if not remainder.is_zero:
            basis.append(remainder.monic(order))
    pairs = list(combinations(range(len(basis)), 2))
    processed: set[tuple[int, int]] = set()
    batches = matrices = maximum_rows = maximum_columns = maximum_nonzeros = 0
    while True:
        pending = [pair for pair in pairs if pair not in processed]
        if not pending:
            break
        if len(processed) + len(pending) > pair_limit:
            raise RuntimeError("F4 excedeu pair_limit")
        degrees = {pair: sum(_lcm(basis[pair[0]].leading_term(order)[0],
                                  basis[pair[1]].leading_term(order)[0])) for pair in pending}
        minimum_degree = min(degrees.values())
        batch = [pair for pair in pending if degrees[pair] == minimum_degree]
        processed.update(batch)
        sources = [_s_polynomial(basis[left], basis[right], order) for left, right in batch]
        sources = [source for source in sources if not source.is_zero]
        batches += 1
        if not sources:
            continue
        macaulay = build_macaulay_matrix(sources, basis, order=order,
                                         row_limit=row_limit, column_limit=column_limit)
        reduced, _ = _sparse_rref(macaulay.rows)
        matrices += 1
        maximum_rows, maximum_columns = max(maximum_rows, len(reduced)), \
            max(maximum_columns, len(macaulay.monomials))
        maximum_nonzeros = max(maximum_nonzeros,
                               sum(len(row) for row in reduced))
        additions: list[Polynomial] = []
        for row in reduced:
            polynomial = Polynomial(variables, ((macaulay.monomials[column], coefficient)
                                                 for column, coefficient in row.items()))
            if polynomial.is_zero:
                continue
            _, remainder = divide_polynomial(polynomial, (*basis, *additions), order=order)
            if not remainder.is_zero:
                monic = remainder.monic(order)
                if monic not in basis and monic not in additions:
                    additions.append(monic)
        for polynomial in additions:
            new_index = len(basis)
            basis.append(polynomial)
            pairs.extend((index, new_index) for index in range(new_index))
    # Every critical S-polynomial is checked as a postcondition.
    for left, right in combinations(basis, 2):
        _, remainder = divide_polynomial(_s_polynomial(left, right, order), basis, order=order)
        if not remainder.is_zero:
            raise ArithmeticError("Pós-condição de Buchberger falhou após F4")
    return F4Result(tuple(basis), batches, matrices, maximum_rows, maximum_columns,
                    maximum_nonzeros)


__all__ = ["F4Result", "MacaulayMatrix", "build_macaulay_matrix", "f4_basis"]

"""Signature-driven F5 reference algorithm with verified completion.

This implementation uses position-over-term signatures, signature-safe reduction,
rewritable/syzygy criteria and a final Buchberger audit.  Any pairs required by the
audit are completed rather than trusting an unsound criterion implementation.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from itertools import combinations
from typing import Sequence

from .groebner import Monomial, MonomialOrder, Polynomial, divide_polynomial, s_polynomial


def _divides(left: Monomial, right: Monomial) -> bool:
    return all(first <= second for first, second in zip(left, right))


def _quotient(left: Monomial, right: Monomial) -> Monomial:
    return tuple(first - second for first, second in zip(left, right))


def _multiply(left: Monomial, right: Monomial) -> Monomial:
    return tuple(first + second for first, second in zip(left, right))


def _lcm(left: Monomial, right: Monomial) -> Monomial:
    return tuple(max(first, second) for first, second in zip(left, right))


def _monomial_key(value: Monomial, order: MonomialOrder) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    if order == "lex":
        return value
    if order == "grlex":
        return (sum(value), *value)
    return (sum(value), *(-item for item in reversed(value)))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Signature:
    generator: int
    monomial: Monomial


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LabeledPolynomial:
    signature: Signature
    polynomial: Polynomial


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class F5Result:
    basis: tuple[Polynomial, ...]
    labeled_basis: tuple[LabeledPolynomial, ...]
    processed_pairs: int
    rejected_rewritable: int
    rejected_syzygy: int
    completion_pairs: int


def _signature_key(signature: Signature, order: MonomialOrder) -> tuple[object, ...]:
    return (signature.generator, *_monomial_key(signature.monomial, order))


def _scale_signature(signature: Signature, monomial: Monomial) -> Signature:
    return Signature(signature.generator, _multiply(signature.monomial, monomial))


def _maximum_signature(left: Signature, right: Signature,
                       order: MonomialOrder) -> Signature:
    return max((left, right), key=lambda item: _signature_key(item, order))


def _signature_safe_reduce(labeled: LabeledPolynomial,
                           basis: Sequence[LabeledPolynomial],
                           order: MonomialOrder) -> LabeledPolynomial:
    current = labeled.polynomial
    remainder = Polynomial.zero(current.variables)
    while not current.is_zero:
        leading, coefficient = current.leading_term(order)
        reducer = None
        for candidate in basis:
            candidate_leading, candidate_coefficient = candidate.polynomial.leading_term(order)
            if not _divides(candidate_leading, leading):
                continue
            multiplier = _quotient(leading, candidate_leading)
            scaled = _scale_signature(candidate.signature, multiplier)
            if _signature_key(scaled, order) < _signature_key(labeled.signature, order):
                reducer = candidate, multiplier, candidate_coefficient
                break
        if reducer is None:
            term = Polynomial(current.variables, {leading: coefficient})
            remainder, current = remainder + term, current - term
        else:
            candidate, multiplier, candidate_coefficient = reducer
            current = current - candidate.polynomial.multiply_term(
                multiplier, coefficient / candidate_coefficient
            )
    return LabeledPolynomial(labeled.signature, remainder)


def f5_basis(generators: Sequence[Polynomial], *, order: MonomialOrder = "grevlex",
             pair_limit: int = 100_000) -> F5Result:
    if not generators:
        return F5Result((), (), 0, 0, 0, 0)
    variables = generators[0].variables
    if any(item.variables != variables for item in generators):
        raise ValueError("Geradores pertencem a anéis diferentes")
    unit = (0,) * len(variables)
    labeled: list[LabeledPolynomial] = []
    known_signatures: list[Signature] = []
    leading_ideals: list[list[Monomial]] = [[] for _ in generators]
    for index, generator in enumerate(generators):
        if generator.is_zero:
            continue
        candidate = LabeledPolynomial(Signature(index, unit), generator.monic(order))
        reduced = _signature_safe_reduce(candidate, labeled, order)
        if not reduced.polynomial.is_zero:
            labeled.append(LabeledPolynomial(reduced.signature, reduced.polynomial.monic(order)))
            known_signatures.append(reduced.signature)
            leading_ideals[index].append(reduced.polynomial.leading_term(order)[0])
    pairs = list(combinations(range(len(labeled)), 2))
    cursor = processed = rewritable = syzygy = 0
    while cursor < len(pairs):
        if processed >= pair_limit:
            raise RuntimeError("F5 excedeu pair_limit")
        left_index, right_index = pairs[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        processed += 1
        left, right = labeled[left_index], labeled[right_index]
        left_leading = left.polynomial.leading_term(order)[0]
        right_leading = right.polynomial.leading_term(order)[0]
        common = _lcm(left_leading, right_leading)
        left_signature = _scale_signature(left.signature, _quotient(common, left_leading))
        right_signature = _scale_signature(right.signature, _quotient(common, right_leading))
        signature = _maximum_signature(left_signature, right_signature, order)
        if any(existing.generator == signature.generator
               and _divides(existing.monomial, signature.monomial)
               and existing != signature for existing in known_signatures):
            rewritable += 1
            continue
        if any(_divides(monomial, signature.monomial)
               for generator_index, ideal in enumerate(leading_ideals)
               if generator_index < signature.generator for monomial in ideal):
            syzygy += 1
            continue
        candidate = LabeledPolynomial(signature,
                                      s_polynomial(left.polynomial, right.polynomial, order))
        reduced = _signature_safe_reduce(candidate, labeled, order)
        known_signatures.append(signature)
        if reduced.polynomial.is_zero:
            continue
        polynomial = reduced.polynomial.monic(order)
        new_index = len(labeled)
        labeled.append(LabeledPolynomial(signature, polynomial))
        leading_ideals[signature.generator].append(polynomial.leading_term(order)[0])
        pairs.extend((index, new_index) for index in range(new_index))

    # Verified completion retains correctness even when a signature criterion is conservative.
    completion = 0
    basis = [item.polynomial for item in labeled]
    while True:
        addition = None
        for left, right in combinations(basis, 2):
            _, remainder = divide_polynomial(s_polynomial(left, right, order), basis, order=order)
            if not remainder.is_zero:
                addition = remainder.monic(order)
                break
        if addition is None:
            break
        completion += 1
        basis.append(addition)
        labeled.append(LabeledPolynomial(Signature(len(generators) - 1, unit), addition))
        if processed + completion > pair_limit:
            raise RuntimeError("Conclusão verificada de F5 excedeu pair_limit")
    return F5Result(tuple(basis), tuple(labeled), processed, rewritable, syzygy, completion)


__all__ = ["F5Result", "LabeledPolynomial", "Signature", "f5_basis"]

"""Corpos finitos explícitos derivados de anéis finitos validados."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from itertools import product
from typing import Generic, TypeVar

from .rings import FiniteRing, integers_modulo
from ..number_theory.elementary import is_prime

T = TypeVar("T")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FiniteField(Generic[T]):
    ring: FiniteRing[T]

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for left, right in product(self.ring.elements, repeat=2):
            if self.ring.multiply(left, right) != self.ring.multiply(right, left): raise ValueError("multiplicação não comutativa")
        if set(self.ring.units()) != set(self.ring.elements) - {self.ring.zero}:
            raise ValueError("todo elemento não nulo precisa ser invertível")

    def inverse(self, value: T) -> T:
        if value == self.ring.zero: raise ZeroDivisionError("zero não possui inverso")
        for candidate in self.ring.elements:
            if self.ring.multiply(value, candidate) == self.ring.one: return candidate
        raise AssertionError("corpo validado sem inverso")

    def divide(self, numerator: T, denominator: T) -> T:
        return self.ring.multiply(numerator, self.inverse(denominator))


def prime_field(characteristic: int) -> FiniteField[int]:
    if not is_prime(characteristic): raise ValueError("característica deve ser prima")
    return FiniteField(integers_modulo(characteristic))


__all__ = ["FiniteField", "prime_field"]
