def test_all_new_operations_replay_and_snapshot(tmp_path):
    notebook = Notebook('Scientific ecosystem')
    for operation,arguments in CASES.items():
        calculation = CalculationSession().execute(operation,**arguments)
        data = calculation.to_data()
        assert verify_receipt(data)
        notebook.append(calculation)
        corrupted = deepcopy(data); corrupted['result'] = None
        assert not verify_receipt(corrupted)
    path = tmp_path/'notebook.json'; notebook.save(path)
    assert Notebook.load(path).replay() == len(CASES)


def test_tensor_broadcast_matmul_and_budget():
    assert tensor_operation('multiply',[[1],[2]],other=[3,4])['values'] == [[3,4],[6,8]]
    assert tensor_operation('matmul',[[1,2],[3,4]],other=[[2],[1]])['values'] == [[4],[10]]
    assert tensor_operation('sum',[[1,2],[3,4]],axis=0)['values'] == [4,6]
    assert tensor_operation('transpose',[[1,2],[3,4]])['values'] == [[1,3],[2,4]]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError,match='Broadcast'):
        tensor_operation('add',[[1]]*101,other=[1]*100)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        tensor_operation('reshape',[1,2],shape=[3])


def test_shared_dynamic_graph_and_malformed_references():
    # f(x,y) = x*x + x*y, df/dx=2x+y, df/dy=x.
    nodes = [{'op':'input','name':'x'},{'op':'input','name':'y'},
             {'op':'multiply','args':[0,0]},{'op':'multiply','args':[0,1]},
             {'op':'add','args':[2,3]}]
    result = differentiate_graph(nodes,{'x':3,'y':4},4)
    assert result['value'] == 21 and result['gradient'] == {'x':10,'y':3}
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        differentiate_graph([{'op':'add','args':[0,0]}],{'x':1},0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        differentiate_graph([{'op':'eval','value':'__import__("os")'}],{'x':1},0)


def test_seeded_mcmc_moments_and_rejection():
    result = sample_normal(2,1,samples=12000,burn_in=1000,seed=31)
    values = [v[0] for v in result['samples']]
    assert abs(sum(values)/len(values)-2) < 0.08
    assert abs(sum((v-2)**2 for v in values)/len(values)-1) < 0.12
    assert 0 < result['acceptance_rate'] < 1
    assert sample_normal(0,1,samples=10,seed=3) == sample_normal(0,1,samples=10,seed=3)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        metropolis_hastings(lambda x: math.nan,[0])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        sample_normal(0,0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        sample_normal(0,1,samples=True)


def test_conjugate_posterior_matches_closed_form():
    result = beta_binomial(3,5,alpha='1/2',beta='1/2')
    assert result['alpha'] == '7/2' and result['beta'] == '5/2'
    assert Fraction(result['mean']) == Fraction(7,12)
    assert Fraction(result['variance']) == Fraction(35,1008)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        beta_binomial(6,5)

def test_bell_density_trace_and_amplitude_damping():
    result = simulate_circuit(2,[{'gate':'H','target':0},{'gate':'CX','control':0,'target':1}],shots=100,seed=7,density_matrix=True)
    assert result['probabilities'] == pytest.approx([.5,0,0,.5])
    assert set(result['counts']) == {'00','11'} and sum(result['counts'].values()) == 100
    density = result['density_matrix']
    assert sum(density[i][i][0] for i in range(4)) == pytest.approx(1)
    np = pytest.importorskip('numpy')
    gamma = .25
    channel = [np.array([[1,0],[0,math.sqrt(1-gamma)]]),np.array([[0,math.sqrt(gamma)],[0,0]])]
    assert apply_channel([[0,0],[0,1]],channel) == pytest.approx(np.diag([.25,.75]))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        apply_channel([[1,0],[0,-1]],channel)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        simulate_circuit(1,[{'gate':'CX','control':0,'target':0}])


def test_lp_milp_and_nonlinear_independent_optima():
    pytest.importorskip('scipy')
    from nablamath.ops.convex_optimization import minimize_linear, minimize_nonlinear
    lp = minimize_linear([-1,-1],constraints=[[1,2]],upper=[3],bounds=[(0,2),(0,2)])
    assert lp['success'] and lp['value'] == pytest.approx(-2.5) and lp['max_constraint_violation'] < 1e-8
    mip = minimize_linear([-1,-1],constraints=[[1,2]],upper=[3],bounds=[(0,2),(0,2)],integrality=[1,1])
    assert mip['success'] and mip['value'] == pytest.approx(-2)
    infeasible = minimize_linear([1],constraints=[[1]],lower=[2],upper=[3],bounds=[(0,1)])
    assert not infeasible['success'] and infeasible['point'] is None
    nonlinear = minimize_nonlinear(lambda x: (x[0]-3)**2,[0])
    assert nonlinear['success'] and nonlinear['point'][0] == pytest.approx(3,abs=1e-5)

    assert record['replayable'] is False

def test_older_published_artifacts_verify_with_their_original_print_profile(tmp_path):
    import hashlib
    from nablamath.documents.document_model import Document,Section
    from nablamath.documents.publication import publish,verify_publication
    from nablamath.documents.legacy_exporters import to_html,to_latex,to_typst
    document=Document('Legacy paper',(Section('Result','A preserved historical result'),))
    root=tmp_path/'legacy';publish(document,root)
    manifest=json.loads((root/'manifest.json').read_text());manifest.pop('render_profile')
    for suffix,exporter in [('html',to_html),('tex',to_latex),('typ',to_typst)]:
        path=root/('document.'+suffix);path.write_text(exporter(document),encoding='utf-8')
        manifest['files'][path.name]=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    (root/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
    assert verify_publication(root)
    manifest['render_profile']='unknown';(root/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest))

def test_signed_living_paper_has_readable_audit_footer_on_every_page(tmp_path):
    pytest.importorskip('typst');pypdf=pytest.importorskip('pypdf');pytest.importorskip('cryptography')
    from nablamath.artifacts.bundle import create_bundle
    from nablamath.calc import CalculationSession
    from nablamath.federation.crypto_registry import CryptoRegistry,generate_key,public_key_hex,sign
    from nablamath.publishing import TypstCompiler,verify_publication
    bundle=create_bundle([CalculationSession().execute('binomial',n=5,k=2).to_data()])
    key=generate_key();trust=CryptoRegistry();trust.pin('layout-test',public_key_hex(key));signature=sign(bundle,key,signer='layout-test')
    template=tmp_path/'pages.typ';template.write_text('#for i in range(3) [\n= Audited page #i\nResult: {{value}}\n#if i < 2 { pagebreak() }\n]')
    paper=TypstCompiler(trust=trust,require_signature=True).compile(bundle,tmp_path/'signed.pdf',template=template,signature=signature)
    pages=pypdf.PdfReader(paper.pdf).pages

from fractions import Fraction
import json
import unittest

from nablamath.expression import Binary, DomainError, Symbol, evaluate, parse_expr, render
from nablamath.symbolic.egraph import saturate


class EqualitySaturationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_folds_constants_and_removes_neutral_elements(self):
        result = saturate(parse_expr("(2 + 3) * (x + 0)"))
        self.assertEqual(evaluate(result.expression, {"x": Fraction(4)}), 20)
        self.assertLess(result.cost, 7)
        self.assertTrue(any(event.rule == "constant_fold" for event in result.proof))

    def test_extracts_factored_form_with_operation_cost(self):
        result = saturate(
            parse_expr("a*b + a*c"),
            operation_costs={"+": 1, "*": 10, "symbol": 0},
        )
        self.assertEqual(render(result.expression), "(a * (b + c))")
        self.assertTrue(any(event.rule == "factor_common_left" for event in result.proof))
        self.assertEqual(result.to_data()["operation_costs"], {"+": 1.0, "*": 10.0, "symbol": 0.0})

    def test_does_not_erase_partial_domain_with_zero_product(self):
        result = saturate(parse_expr("0 * (1/x)"))
        self.assertIsInstance(result.expression, Binary)
        with self.assertRaises(DomainError):
            evaluate(result.expression, {"x": Fraction(0)})

    def test_is_deterministic_and_bounded(self):
        expression = parse_expr("a+b+c+d")
        first = saturate(expression, iteration_limit=2, node_limit=20)
        second = saturate(expression, iteration_limit=2, node_limit=20)
        self.assertEqual(first.expression, second.expression)
        self.assertEqual(first.proof, second.proof)
        self.assertEqual(first.content_id, second.content_id)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(json.dumps(first.to_data()))["content_id"], first.content_id)
        self.assertLessEqual(first.node_count, 20)
        self.assertEqual(first.stop_reason, "node_limit")

    def test_rejects_invalid_budgets(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            saturate(Symbol("x"), iteration_limit=0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            saturate(parse_expr("x+y"), node_limit=2)

    def test_rejects_costs_that_make_extraction_ill_defined(self):
        for cost in (-1, float("inf"), float("nan")):
            with self.subTest(cost=cost), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                saturate(Symbol("x"), operation_costs={"symbol": cost})

    def test_reports_natural_saturation(self):
        result = saturate(Symbol("x"))
        self.assertTrue(result.saturated)
        self.assertEqual(result.stop_reason, "saturated")
        self.assertEqual(result.iterations, 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest

class ExpressionEntityTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_semantic_identity_ignores_source_whitespace(self):
        a = ExpressionEntity.parse("x + y")
        b = ExpressionEntity.parse("(x+y)")
        self.assertEqual(a.expression, b.expression)
        self.assertEqual(a.content_id, b.content_id)

    def test_assumptions_are_part_of_identity(self):
        plain = ExpressionEntity.parse("x/x")
        constrained = ExpressionEntity.parse("x/x", nonzero=("x",))
        self.assertNotEqual(plain.content_id, constrained.content_id)
        optimized = constrained.optimize(operation_costs={"/": 10, "number": 0, "symbol": 0})
        self.assertEqual(str(optimized.expression.value), "1")

    def test_representations_share_one_semantic_source(self):
        entity = ExpressionEntity.parse("(x+x)/3")
        values = {"x": Fraction(5, 2)}
        exact = entity.evaluate(values)
        compiled = entity.compile(backend="python")(values)
        self.assertEqual(exact, compiled)
        descriptor = entity.descriptor()
        self.assertEqual(descriptor["content_id"], entity.content_id)
        self.assertIn("\\frac", entity.latex())

    def test_formal_statement_preserves_entity_assumptions(self):
        entity = ExpressionEntity.parse("x/x", nonzero=("x",))
        source = entity.equivalence_theorem(parse_expr("1"), theorem_name="entity_div_self")
        self.assertIn("(h0 : nabla_x ≠ 0)", source)
        self.assertNotIn("sorry", source)

def test_document_references_resolve_to_real_artifact_nodes():
    artifact = build_scientific_artifact(family="linear_system", seed=42, license_id="MIT", provenance="synthetic test")
    certificate = next(node for node in artifact.nodes if node.kind == "verification")
    document = Document("Report", (Section("Result", "Exact instance", evidence_ids=(certificate.content_id,)),))
    report = document_reference_graph(document, artifact)

def test_receipt_quorum_is_distinct_and_does_not_establish_truth():
    expected = fingerprint({"exact": 2})
    receipts = [{"participant_id": "a", "result_id": expected},
                {"participant_id": "b", "result_id": expected},
                {"participant_id": "c", "result_id": "0"*64}]
    report = receipt_consensus(receipts, expected_result_id=expected)
    assert report["quorum_met"] and report["disagreeing"] == ["c"]
    assert not report["scientific_truth_established"]
    assert not receipt_consensus(receipts[:1], expected_result_id=expected)["quorum_met"]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        receipt_consensus(receipts + [receipts[0]], expected_result_id=expected)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        receipt_consensus(receipts, expected_result_id=expected, quorum=True)


def test_longitudinal_monitor_replays_fixed_cohort_and_flags_decline():
    task = ScientificTask("linear_system", matrix=((1,),), rhs=(1,))
    baseline = [{"task_id": task.content_id, "values": ["0"]}]
    protocol = FrozenEvaluation.freeze(tasks=[task], baseline=baseline, policy="fixed cohort",
        actors=IndependencePolicy("a", "b", "c", "d"),
        lineage=[{"id": task.content_id, "split": "test", "parents": [], "groups": {}},
                 {"id": "train", "split": "train", "parents": [], "groups": {}}])
    observations = []
    for step, value in enumerate(["1", "0", "1"]):
        submission = {"protocol_id": protocol.protocol_id, "predictions": [{"task_id": task.content_id, "values": [value]}]}
        observations.append({"step": step, "model_id": fingerprint({"model": step}),
                             "submission": submission, "report": protocol.evaluate(submission)})
    report = monitor_evaluations(protocol, observations)
    assert [row["regression"] for row in report["observations"]] == [False, True, False]
    assert [row["delta_previous"] for row in report["observations"]] == [None, "-1", "1"]
    assert not report["deployment_performed"]
    for mutate in [lambda rows: rows.reverse(), lambda rows: rows[1].update(model_id=rows[0]["model_id"]),
                   lambda rows: rows[1]["report"].update(candidate_correct=1)]:
        forged = copy.deepcopy(observations)
        mutate(forged)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            monitor_evaluations(protocol, forged)

class FluidsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_profile_and_independent_quadrature(self):
        pipe = PipeFlow(radius_m=.01, length_m=2, pressure_drop_pa=5,
                        dynamic_viscosity_pa_s=1, density_kg_m3=1000)

            PipeFlow(0, 1, 1, 1, 1)
        high = PipeFlow(.1, 1, 10000, .001, 1000).solve()
        self.assertFalse(high.laminar_regime_compatible)

    def test_exact_inverse_construction_each_family(self):

                self.assertTrue(all(record['checks'].values()))
                self.assertEqual(frontier.fingerprint({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k not in ('receipt','record_sha256')}), record['record_sha256'])
                self.assertTrue(frontier.portable_verify(record['receipt']))
                replay=frontier.create_record(i,frontier.portable_receipt,frontier.portable_verify,'portable_reference_contract')
                self.assertEqual(record,replay)

        self.assertFalse(frontier.portable_verify(forged))
        forged=copy.deepcopy(record['receipt'])
        forged['content_id']='0'*64
        self.assertFalse(frontier.portable_verify(forged))

            self.assertEqual(sum(ma['domains'].values()),25)
            self.assertEqual(len(ma['domains']),5)
            self.assertTrue(ma['unique_record_hashes'])
            self.assertEqual(ma['file_sha256'],hashlib.sha256(a.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
            self.assertEqual(a.read_text().count('PROBLEM_ID:'),25)

        self.assertEqual(len({r['domain'] for r in self.records}),10)
        self.assertEqual(self.manifest['distinct_operator_grammars'],100)

    def test_sealed_family_disjoint_split(self):
        tr={r['domain'] for r in self.records if r['split']=='train'}
        ev={r['domain'] for r in self.records if r['split']=='test_unseen_family'}
        self.assertEqual(len(tr),8)
        self.assertEqual(len(ev),2)
        self.assertFalse(tr & ev)
        self.assertEqual(self.manifest['train_count'],80)
        self.assertEqual(self.manifest['test_unseen_family_count'],20)

            x=dict(r);ident=x.pop('record_sha256'); receipt=x.pop('receipt')
            self.assertEqual(foundry.digest(x),ident)
            self.assertTrue(foundry.portable_verify(receipt))

        self.assertTrue(foundry.verify_dataset(self.output,True))
        data=self.output.read_bytes()

    def test_grade_all_families(self):
        for record in self.records:
            self.assertTrue(foundry.grade_answer(record['answer'],record['answer']))

    def test_grade_rational_equivalence(self):
        self.assertTrue(foundry.grade_answer({'a':'1/2','b':['2/4']},{'a':'2/4','b':['1/2']}))
        self.assertFalse(foundry.grade_answer({'a':'1/2'},{'a':0.5}))
        self.assertFalse(foundry.grade_answer({'a':1},{'a':True}))

    def test_adversarial_tampering_rejected_on_all_100(self):
        for record in self.records:
            self.assertFalse(foundry.grade_answer(record['answer'],foundry.mutate(record['answer'])))
            altered=copy.deepcopy(record['receipt'])
            altered['content_id']='0'*64
            self.assertFalse(foundry.portable_verify(altered))

    def test_reject_missing_and_extra_answer_keys(self):

            self.assertFalse(foundry.grade_answer(r['answer'],bad))
            bad=copy.deepcopy(r['answer']);bad['INJECTED']=True
            self.assertFalse(foundry.grade_answer(r['answer'],bad))

    def test_replay_rejects_corrupted_dataset(self):

            self.assertFalse(foundry.verify_dataset(self.output,True))
        finally:self.output.write_bytes(original)

    def test_model_scoring_and_failure_curriculum(self):

import unittest

from nablamath.gpu.batch_mcts_kernel import MCTSConfig, batch_mcts
from nablamath.gpu.cuda_f4_reduction import modular_rref
from nablamath.gpu.neural_guide import QuantizedLinearGuide
from nablamath.gpu.tensor_egraph import PackedENode, TensorEGraph
from nablamath.gpu.vram_buffer_manager import BufferManager


class GpuPrimitivesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_buffer_manager_is_content_addressed_and_budgeted(self):
        with BufferManager(8) as manager:
            first = manager.put(b"abcd")
            second = manager.put(b"abcd")
            self.assertEqual(first, second)
            self.assertFalse(first.accelerated)
            self.assertEqual(manager.used_bytes, 4)
            self.assertEqual(manager.get(first), b"abcd")
            manager.release(first)
            self.assertEqual(manager.used_bytes, 4)
            manager.release(second)
            self.assertEqual(manager.used_bytes, 0)
            with self.assertRaises(MemoryError):
                manager.put(b"123456789")

    def test_modular_rref_is_exact_and_receipted(self):
        result = modular_rref(((1, 2, 3), (2, 4, 7)), 101)
        self.assertEqual(result.rank, 2)
        self.assertEqual(result.pivots, (0, 2))
        self.assertEqual(result.matrix, ((1, 2, 0), (0, 0, 1)))
        self.assertFalse(result.accelerated)
        self.assertEqual(len(result.content_id), 64)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            modular_rref(((1,),), 15)

    def test_tensor_egraph_batched_union_and_congruence(self):
        graph = TensorEGraph(4)
        self.assertEqual(graph.union_batch(((0, 1), (2, 3))), 2)
        self.assertEqual(graph.components(), ((0, 1), (2, 3)))
        self.assertEqual(graph.add_nodes((PackedENode(1, 0, 2), PackedENode(1, 1, 3))), 1)

    def test_quantized_guide_ranks_actions(self):
        guide = QuantizedLinearGuide.quantize(("expand", "factor"), ((1, -1), (-1, 1)))
        ranking = guide.rank((1, -1))
        self.assertEqual(ranking[0][0], "expand")
        self.assertGreater(ranking[0][1], ranking[1][1])

    def test_batched_mcts_finds_rewarding_action(self):
        result = batch_mcts(
            0,
            actions=lambda state: (1, 2) if state == 0 else (),
            transition=lambda state, action: action,
            terminal=lambda state: state != 0,
            evaluate=lambda states: [1.0 if state == 2 else 0.0 for state in states],
            config=MCTSConfig(simulations=64, batch_size=8, seed=4),
        )
        self.assertEqual(result.action, 2)
        self.assertEqual(result.simulations, 64)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import math
import unittest

from nablamath.autodiff import Var
from nablamath.physics.fluids import solve_incompressible_periodic


class IncompressibleNavierStokesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_uniform_velocity_is_exact_fixed_point(self):
        u=[[2.0]*8 for _ in range(6)]
        v=[[-0.5]*8 for _ in range(6)]
        result=solve_incompressible_periodic(
            u,v,2.0,1.5,0.01,0.02,steps=4,pressure_iterations=12
        )
        for row in result.u_m_s:
            for value in row:
                self.assertAlmostEqual(float(value),2.0,places=13)
        for row in result.v_m_s:
            for value in row:
                self.assertAlmostEqual(float(value),-0.5,places=13)
        self.assertLess(result.divergence_l2(),1e-13)

    def test_projection_reduces_divergence(self):
        nx=ny=12
        u=[[math.sin(2*math.pi*i/nx) for i in range(nx)] for _ in range(ny)]
        v=[[0.5*math.sin(2*math.pi*j/ny) for _ in range(nx)] for j in range(ny)]
        dx=dy=1.0/nx
        def divergence_l2(uu,vv):
            total=0.0
            for j in range(ny):
                jm,jp=(j-1)%ny,(j+1)%ny
                for i in range(nx):
                    im,ip=(i-1)%nx,(i+1)%nx
                    d=(uu[j][ip]-uu[j][im])/(2*dx)+(vv[jp][i]-vv[jm][i])/(2*dy)
                    total+=d*d
            return math.sqrt(total/(nx*ny))
        before=divergence_l2(u,v)
        result=solve_incompressible_periodic(
            u,v,1.0,1.0,0.002,0.01,steps=1,pressure_iterations=120
        )
        self.assertLess(result.divergence_l2(),0.35*before)

    def test_viscosity_path_is_differentiable(self):
        nx=ny=6
        u=[[0.15*math.sin(2*math.pi*j/ny) for _ in range(nx)] for j in range(ny)]
        v=[[0.15*math.sin(2*math.pi*i/nx) for i in range(nx)] for _ in range(ny)]
        viscosity=Var(0.03)
        result=solve_incompressible_periodic(
            u,v,1.0,1.0,0.002,viscosity,steps=1,pressure_iterations=16
        )
        energy=result.kinetic_energy()
        self.assertIsInstance(energy,Var)
        energy.backward()
        self.assertTrue(math.isfinite(viscosity.grad))
        self.assertLess(viscosity.grad,0.0)

    def test_stability_guard_rejects_excessive_step(self):
        u=[[10.0]*4 for _ in range(4)]
        v=[[0.0]*4 for _ in range(4)]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            solve_incompressible_periodic(
                u,v,1.0,1.0,1.0,0.1,steps=1,pressure_iterations=4
            )


if __name__=="__main__":
    unittest.main()

@pytest.fixture
def paper(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    bundle = create_bundle([receipt('publication-regression', {}, {'value': 7})])
    template = tmp_path / 'paper.typ'
    template.write_text('= Auditable paper\n', encoding='utf-8')

    def render(_bundle, destination, **kwargs):
        destination = Path(destination)
        destination.write_bytes(b'%PDF-1.7\nfixture-rendered\n')
        return SimpleNamespace(pdf=destination)

    def write(source, destination, _bundle, **kwargs):
        Path(destination).write_bytes(Path(source).read_bytes() + b'%verified-bundle\n')
        return {}

    def inspect(path, **kwargs):
        if not Path(path).read_bytes().startswith(b'%PDF-1.7'):
            raise ValueError('Damaged PDF')
        return {'bundle': bundle}

    monkeypatch.setattr(compiler.renderer, 'compile', render)
    monkeypatch.setattr(VerifiablePDFWriter, 'write', write)
    monkeypatch.setattr(VerifiablePDFWriter, 'inspect', inspect)
    return compiler, output


def test_cache_hit_requires_intact_pdf_and_audit(paper):
    compiler, output = paper
    initial = compiler.build()
    assert initial.changed
    assert not compiler.build().changed
    manifest = json.loads(initial.manifest.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    audit = output.parent / 'audit.html'
    assert manifest['audit_sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(audit.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert manifest['artifact_sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(initial.artifact.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert manifest['source_sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(initial.source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


@pytest.mark.parametrize('damage', ['delete_audit', 'modify_audit', 'modify_pdf', 'delete_pdf'])
def test_stable_publication_is_recovered_from_verified_revision(paper, damage):
    compiler, output = paper
    initial = compiler.build()
    original_pdf = output.read_bytes()
    audit = output.parent / 'audit.html'
    original_audit = audit.read_bytes()

    if damage == 'delete_audit':
        audit.unlink()
    elif damage == 'modify_audit':
        audit.write_bytes(b'forged HTML')
    elif damage == 'modify_pdf':
        output.write_bytes(b'%PDF-1.7\nforged PDF')
    else:
        output.unlink()

    recovered = compiler.build()
    assert recovered.changed
    assert recovered.revision == initial.revision
    assert output.read_bytes() == original_pdf
    assert audit.read_bytes() == original_audit
    assert not compiler.build().changed


@pytest.mark.parametrize('name', ['paper.pdf', 'audit.html', 'artifact.json', 'compiled.source',
                                  'template.source', 'provenance-badge.svg'])
def test_tampered_immutable_revision_fails_closed(paper, name):
    compiler, output = paper
    initial = compiler.build()
    original_pdf = output.read_bytes()
    immutable_file = initial.manifest.parent / name
    immutable_file.write_bytes(immutable_file.read_bytes() + b'ATTACK')

    # Even an otherwise healthy stable PDF/audit must not mask a corrupted
    # immutable revision during a cache hit.
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='altered'):
        compiler.build()
    assert output.read_bytes() == original_pdf

def test_watcher_repairs_deleted_audit_without_new_receipt(paper):
    compiler, output = paper
    with compiler.watch(delay=.05) as watcher:
        original = watcher.wait_for_build(count=1, timeout=10)
        audit = output.parent / 'audit.html'
        original_bytes = audit.read_bytes()
        audit.unlink()
        rebuilt = watcher.wait_for_build(count=2, timeout=10)
        assert rebuilt.revision == original.revision
        assert audit.read_bytes() == original_bytes
        assert watcher.status()['error'] is None

def rehash(root, name):
    manifest = json.loads((root / 'manifest.json').read_text())
    manifest['files'][name] = hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    (root / 'manifest.json').write_text(canonical_json(manifest))

def workload(tmp_path_factory):
    root = tmp_path_factory.mktemp('lab') / 'run'
    summary = run_laboratory_workload(root, per_family=1, seed=18951, parquet=False)
    return root, summary

def test_orchestrator_keeps_failures_timeouts_and_continues(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import importlib.util
    import subprocess
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('laboratory_cli', Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'tools/simulate_frontier_lab.py')
    cli = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(cli)
    calls = []
    def execute(command, **options):
        calls.append(command)
        assert options['check'] is False
        assert 'shell' not in options
        if len(calls) == 2:
            raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired(command, options['timeout'])
        return SimpleNamespace(returncode=1 if len(calls) == 1 else 0)
    monkeypatch.setattr(cli.subprocess, 'run', execute)
    root = tmp_path / 'campaign'
    args = SimpleNamespace(destination=root, per_family=1, seed=42, timeout=10)
    assert cli.run(args) is False
    summary = json.loads((root / 'summary.json').read_text())
    assert [row['status'] for row in summary['jobs']] == ['failed', 'timeout', 'passed', 'passed', 'passed']
    assert len(calls) == 5
    assert not summary['all_jobs_passed']
    assert summary['selected_phase_profiles_passed'] == 0
    assert not summary['vision_target_demonstrated']
    assert summary['vision_completion_percent'] is None
    assert len(summary['phase_profiles']) == 12
    with pytest.raises(FileExistsError):
        cli.run(args)

import math
import unittest

from nablamath.autodiff import Var
from nablamath.physics.plasma import MU0, solve_linear_resistive_alfven


class LinearMHDTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_zero_perturbation_is_fixed_point(self):
        result=solve_linear_resistive_alfven(
            [0.0]*16,[0.0]*16,1.0,1e-7,1e-6,0.01,0.1,0.1,steps=4
        )
        self.assertTrue(all(float(x)==0.0 for x in result.velocity_m_s))
        self.assertTrue(all(float(x)==0.0 for x in result.magnetic_perturbation_t))

    def test_alfven_speed_matches_definition(self):
        rho=2e-6
        field=0.02
        result=solve_linear_resistive_alfven(
            [0.0]*8,[0.0]*8,2.0,1e-8,rho,field,0.0,0.0,steps=1
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            result.alfven_speed_m_s,
            abs(field)/math.sqrt(MU0*rho),
            places=12,
        )

    def test_resistive_energy_sensitivity_is_negative(self):
        n=12
        magnetic=[1e-4*math.sin(2*math.pi*i/n) for i in range(n)]
        eta=Var(0.05)
        result=solve_linear_resistive_alfven(
            [0.0]*n,magnetic,1.0,2e-8,1e-4,0.005,eta,0.01,steps=2
        )
        energy=result.energy_j_per_m2()
        self.assertIsInstance(energy,Var)
        energy.backward()
        self.assertTrue(math.isfinite(eta.grad))
        self.assertLess(eta.grad,0.0)

    def test_stability_guard(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            solve_linear_resistive_alfven(
                [0.0]*4,[0.0]*4,1.0,1.0,1.0,1.0,0.0,0.0,steps=1
            )


if __name__=="__main__":
    unittest.main()

def test_exterior_algebra_pullback_and_stokes_reference(sp):
    from nablamath.math.geometry.differential_forms import exterior_derivative,wedge,pullback,integrate_box
    d=exterior_derivative(['x','y'],{'0':'x*y'})

    assert wedge(['x','y'],{'0':'1'},{'1':'1'})=={'0,1':'1'}
    assert wedge(['x','y'],{'1':'1'},{'0':'1'})=={'0,1':'-1'}

def test_presented_categories_and_finite_adjunction():
    from nablamath.math.category_theory.categories import PresentedCategory,Morphism,discrete_category
    from nablamath.math.category_theory.functors import identity_functor,adjunction
    category=PresentedCategory(('A',),(Morphism('a','A','A'),),((('a','a'),('a',)),))
    assert category.equal(['a','a','a'],['a'])['equal']
    assert category.compose(category.identity('A'),['a'])=={'source':'A','arrows':['a']}
    inverse=PresentedCategory(('A',),(Morphism('a','A','A'),Morphism('b','A','A')),((('a','b'),{'source':'A','arrows':[]}),))
    assert inverse.equal(['a','b'],inverse.identity('A'))['equal']
    discrete=discrete_category(('A','B'));identity=identity_functor(discrete)
    result=adjunction(identity,identity,discrete.identities,discrete.identities)
    assert result['adjunction'] and result['equivalence']

def test_translation_tampering_is_detected():

    from nablamath.formal.lean_bridge import translate_statement
    from nablamath.formal.translation_review import review_translation

def test_parallel_transport_and_euclidean_geodesic(np):

    from nablamath.ops.differential_geometry import geodesic,coordinate_pullback,covariant_derivative
    result=parallel_transport(['x'],[[['1']]],['t'],[1.],duration=1.,steps=5)
    assert result['vectors'][-1][0]==pytest.approx(math.exp(-1),rel=1e-7)
    orbit=geodesic([[1,0],[0,1]],['x','y'],[0,0],[1,2],duration=2,steps=4)
    assert np.allclose(orbit['states'][-1],[2,4,1,2],atol=1e-10)
    pullback=coordinate_pullback([[1,0],[0,1]],['x','y'],['u','v'],['u','2*v'])
    assert pullback['metric']==[['1','0'],['0','4']]
    assert covariant_derivative([[1]],['x'],['x*x'])['components']==[['2*x']]


def test_adaptive_vector_stiff_solution_and_event(np):
    from nablamath.numeric.stiff_ode import solve_stiff_system
    result=solve_stiff_system(['-10*x','-y'],['x','y'],[1.,1.],duration=1.,steps=10)
    assert result['values'][-1][0]==pytest.approx(math.exp(-10),rel=1e-5)
    assert result['values'][-1][1]==pytest.approx(math.exp(-1),rel=1e-6)
    event=solve_stiff_system(['-1'],['x'],[1.],duration=2.,events=[{'source':'x','terminal':True,'direction':-1}])
    assert event['event_times'][0][0]==pytest.approx(1.,abs=1e-8)


def test_cartesian_poisson_manufactured_sine_eigenfunction(np):
    from nablamath.numeric.pde_general import poisson_cartesian
    n=8;grid=np.arange(1,n+1)/(n+1);u=np.sin(np.pi*grid)[:,None]*np.sin(np.pi*grid)[None,:]
    eigenvalue=8*(n+1)**2*math.sin(math.pi/(2*(n+1)))**2
    solution=poisson_cartesian([n,n],(eigenvalue*u).tolist())
    assert np.allclose(solution['interior_values'],u,atol=1e-12)
    assert solution['residual_inf']<1e-10


def test_fem_dirichlet_neumann_robin_and_unanchored_rejection(np):
    from nablamath.numeric.pde_general import poisson_fem_1d,adaptive_poisson_1d
    nodes=np.linspace(0,1,9).tolist();zero={'kind':'dirichlet','value':0.}
    result=poisson_fem_1d(nodes,'2',zero,zero)
    assert np.allclose(result['values'],[x*(1-x) for x in nodes],atol=1e-12)
    linear=poisson_fem_1d(nodes,'0',zero,{'kind':'neumann','value':1.})
    assert np.allclose(linear['values'],nodes)
    robin=poisson_fem_1d(nodes,'0',zero,{'kind':'robin','alpha':1.,'value':2.})
    assert np.allclose(robin['values'],nodes)
    adaptive=adaptive_poisson_1d('0',zero,{'kind':'dirichlet','value':1.})
    assert adaptive['requested_estimator_reached']
    with pytest.raises(ValueError,match='Pure Neumann'):
        poisson_fem_1d(nodes,'0',{'kind':'neumann','value':0.},{'kind':'neumann','value':0.})


def test_sde_coupled_brownian_and_deterministic_milstein(np):
    from nablamath.math.probability.stochastic import sde_system,sde_refinement
    path=sde_system(['0'],[['1']],['x'],[0.],duration=1.,steps=2,increments=[[.25],[-.1]])
    assert path['trajectory'][-1][0]==pytest.approx(.15)
    zero=sde_system(['0'],[['0']],['x'],[2.],steps=4,method='milstein')
    assert zero['trajectory']==[[2.]]*5
    pair=sde_refinement(['0'],[['1']],['x'],[0.],steps=4,seed=19)
    assert pair['coupled_final_difference']<1e-12
    with pytest.raises(ValueError,match='independent scalar'):
        sde_system(['0','0'],[['x','y'],['0','y']],['x','y'],[1.,1.],method='milstein')

    volterra=numerical_integral_equation('1','1',kind='volterra',nodes=64)

def test_splines_chebyshev_minimax_and_pade(np):
    from nablamath.ops.approximation_theory import spline,chebyshev_fit,remez_grid,pade
    assert spline([0,1,2],[1,3,5],[.25,1.5])['values']==pytest.approx([1.5,4.])
    fit=chebyshev_fit([-1,0,1],[1,0,1],2,[-.5,.5])
    assert fit['values']==pytest.approx([.25,.25])
    minimax=remez_grid([-1,0,1],[1,0,1],0)
    assert minimax['grid_max_error']==pytest.approx(.5)
    rational=pade([1,1,.5,1/6],1)
    assert rational['numerator_descending'][-1]/rational['denominator_descending'][-1]==pytest.approx(1.)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):spline([0,1],[0,1],[2.])


def test_fft_nufft_and_wavelet_inverse(np):
    from nablamath.ops.spectral import multidimensional_fft,nonuniform_dft,sampling_diagnostics,wavelet_transform
    fft=multidimensional_fft([[1,0],[0,0]])
    assert np.allclose(fft['real'],np.ones((2,2))) and fft['parseval_residual']<1e-12
    direct=nonuniform_dft([0,.25,.5,.75],[1,1,1,1],[0,1])
    assert np.allclose(direct['values'],[[4,0],[0,0]],atol=1e-12)
    assert sampling_diagnostics([1,1,1,1],4)['nyquist_frequency']==2
    pytest.importorskip('pywt')
    signal=np.arange(32).tolist();coefficients=wavelet_transform(signal,'db2',level=2)['coefficients']
    assert np.allclose(wavelet_transform(coefficients,'db2',inverse=True)['values'],signal,atol=1e-12)

def test_ensembles_ising_and_grand_potential(np):

    grand=grand_canonical([0,0],[0,1],chemical_potential=0.)

    assert ising['mean_energy']==pytest.approx(-math.tanh(1.))
    assert ising['magnetization_per_site']==pytest.approx(0.,abs=1e-12)


def test_gaussian_hierarchy_conjugacy_and_posterior_reproducibility(np):
    from nablamath.ops.bayesian_inference import conjugate_update,gaussian_hierarchy,sample_posterior
    assert conjugate_update('gamma_poisson',[2,3],{'shape':1,'rate':1})['mean']=='2'
    normal=conjugate_update('normal_known_variance',[1],{'mean':0,'variance':1,'observation_variance':1})
    assert normal=={'mean':'1/2','variance':'1/2'}
    result=gaussian_hierarchy([[1]],[1],[0],[[1]])
    assert np.allclose(result['posterior_mean'],[.5]) and np.allclose(result['posterior_covariance'],[[.5]])
    config=dict(log_density='-x*x/2',variables=['x'],initials=[[-1.],[1.]],samples=8,burn_in=4,seed=12)
    assert sample_posterior(**config)==sample_posterior(**config)

def test_boundary_potential_and_inverse_gravity(np):
    from nablamath.ops.potential_theory import green_function,boundary_single_layer
    from nablamath.ops.geophysics import gravity_point_masses,tikhonov_inversion,acoustic_wave_2d
    assert green_function(2)['value']==pytest.approx(1/(8*math.pi))
    theta=np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,8,endpoint=False);vertices=np.c_[np.cos(theta),np.sin(theta)].tolist()
    assert boundary_single_layer(vertices,[1.]*8)['residual_inf']<1e-10
    field=gravity_point_masses([[0,0,0]],[1.],[[1.,0,0]])
    assert field['acceleration_m_s2'][0][0]==pytest.approx(-6.67430e-11)
    inverse=tikhonov_inversion([[1]],[2],regularization=1.)
    assert inverse['estimate']==pytest.approx([1.])
    assert np.allclose(acoustic_wave_2d(np.zeros((5,5)).tolist(),1.,1.,.2,2)['final'],0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError,match='CFL'):acoustic_wave_2d(np.zeros((5,5)).tolist(),1.,1.,1.,2)


def test_conic_program_reference_when_solver_installed(np):
    cp=pytest.importorskip('cvxpy')
    if not {'CLARABEL','SCS','CVXOPT'}&set(cp.installed_solvers()):pytest.skip('No supported conic solver installed')
    from nablamath.ops.convex_optimization import conic_program
    # min x subject [[x,1],[1,x]] >= 0, whose exact optimum is x=1.
    result=conic_program([1.],semidefinite=[[[0,1],[1,0]],[[1,0],[0,1]]])
    assert result['point'][0]==pytest.approx(1.,abs=1e-4)
    assert result['max_constraint_violation']<1e-4

class CatalogTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_operations_are_executed_replayed_and_checked(self):
        from nablamath.calc.session import CalculationSession
        from nablamath.calc.catalog import catalog
        from nablamath.calc.catalog import OPERATIONS
        from nablamath.ops.v1_catalog import OPERATIONS as V1_OPERATIONS
        self.assertEqual(set(CATALOG_CASES),set(OPERATIONS)-set(V1_OPERATIONS))
        self.assertTrue(set(CATALOG_CASES)<={r['name'] for r in catalog()['operations']})
        results={}
        for name,kwargs in CATALOG_CASES.items():
            with self.subTest(operation=name):
                receipt=CalculationSession().execute(name,**kwargs)
                self.assertEqual(receipt.to_data(),CalculationSession.replay_request(receipt.to_data()['request']).to_data())
                results[name]=receipt.to_data()['result']
        self.assertEqual(results['matrix_properties']['determinant'],'-2')
        self.assertEqual(results['rational_limit']['result']['status'],'negative_infinity')
        self.assertEqual(results['linear_regression']['slope'],'2')
        self.assertEqual(results['bayes']['posterior']['b'],'3/4')
        self.assertEqual(results['maximum_flow']['value'],'1')
        self.assertTrue(results['sat']['assignment_verified'])
        self.assertAlmostEqual(results['distribution']['cdf'],.5)

    def test_invalid_domains_and_budgets(self):
        from nablamath.calc.session import CalculationSession
        cases=[('matrix_inverse',{'matrix':[[1,1],[1,1]]}),
               ('shortest_paths',{'vertices':['a','b'],'edges':[['a','b',-1]],'source':'a'}),
               ('linear_regression',{'x':[1,1],'y':[2,3]}),
               ('sat',{'clauses':[[0]]}),('distribution',{'kind':'poisson','parameters':{'rate':2},'value':.5})]
        for name,args in cases:
            with self.subTest(operation=name),self.assertRaises(ValueError):CalculationSession().execute(name,**args)


class BasisTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rational_law_and_holdout_not_used_for_selection(self):
        from nablamath.discovery.hypothesis import Observation,ObservationSet
        from nablamath.discovery.basis_search import discover_basis
        # Fractions are required for exact source observations.
        from fractions import Fraction
        train=ObservationSet(tuple(Observation(x,2+Fraction(3,x)) for x in (1,2,3,4)),'synthetic rational fixture','calibration')
        holdout=ObservationSet(tuple(Observation(x,2+Fraction(3,x)) for x in (5,6,7)),'synthetic reserved','holdout')
        result=discover_basis(train,holdout,basis=('1','x','1/x'),max_terms=2)
        self.assertTrue(result['holdout_result']['matches_all'])
        from nablamath.discovery.basis_search import verify_basis_report
        from nablamath.knowledge.provenance_audit import Evidence
        self.assertTrue(verify_basis_report(result))
        evidence=Evidence('discovery',canonical_json(result),'fixture','CC0-1.0',True)
        self.assertTrue(evidence.verify()['valid'])
        altered=copy.deepcopy(result);altered['holdout_result']['matches_all']=False
        self.assertFalse(verify_basis_report(altered))
        wrong=ObservationSet(tuple(Observation(x,100+x) for x in (5,6,7)),'altered holdout','holdout')
        other=discover_basis(train,wrong,basis=('1','x','1/x'),max_terms=2)
        self.assertEqual(result['selected'],other['selected'])
        self.assertFalse(other['holdout_result']['matches_all'])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):discover_basis(train,train)


class DiffusionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_cn_convergence_and_nonzero_boundary_steady_state(self):
        from nablamath.worlds.pde.diffusion import solve_diffusion
        errors=[]
        for cells in (20,40,80):
            initial=[math.sin(math.pi*i/cells) for i in range(cells+1)];initial[-1]=0.
            result=solve_diffusion(initial,steps=cells*2)
            error=max(abs(v-math.exp(-.1*math.pi**2*.1)*math.sin(math.pi*i/cells)) for i,v in enumerate(result['final']))
            errors.append(error)
            self.assertLess(result['discrete_equation_residual'],1e-12)
        self.assertGreater(math.log2(errors[0]/errors[1]),1.9)
        steady=[2+3*i/20 for i in range(21)]
        for method in ('crank_nicolson','backward_euler'):
            result=solve_diffusion(steady,boundary=(2.,5.),steps=2,method=method)
            self.assertLess(max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(steady,result['final'])),1e-12)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):solve_diffusion([0.,1.,1.,1.,0.],steps=1,diffusivity=100,method='ftcs')


class PersistentTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_dataset_batch_atomicity_and_split_leakage(self):
        from nablamath.datasets.schema import make_record
        from nablamath.datasets.store import RecordStore
        def record(seed):
            g=generate_task('linear_system',seed,2)
            return make_record(g.task,g.witness,license_id='CC0-1.0',provenance='fixture',scope='exact',limitations='synthetic',split='train')
        a,b=record(71),record(72)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            store=RecordStore(Path(tmp)/'records.db')
            store.ingest([a],batch_id='first')
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):store.ingest([b,a.with_split('test')],batch_id='failed')
            self.assertEqual(list(RecordStore(store.path).records()),[a])
            store.ingest([b],batch_id='failed')
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):store.ingest([a],batch_id='first')
            self.assertEqual(len(list(store.records())),2)

    def test_agent_resume_replays_prefix_and_keeps_receipt(self):
        from nablamath.agents import ScientificProposal,Action,Planner,Permissions,scientific_registry
        from nablamath.agents.run_store import RunStore
        from nablamath.agents.planner import verify_run
        task=generate_task('linear_system',40,2).task.to_data()
        proposal=ScientificProposal('resume fixture',(
            Action('solve1','solve',canonical_json({'task':task})),
            Action('verify1','verify',canonical_json({'task':task,'candidate':{'$result':{'action':'solve1','path':['candidate']}}}),('solve1',))), 'trusted pure tools')
        planner=Planner(scientific_registry(),Permissions(frozenset({'solve','verify'})))
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            store=RunStore(Path(tmp)/'runs.db')
            partial=planner.run(proposal,store=store,stop_after=1)
            self.assertFalse(partial['completed']);self.assertTrue(verify_run(partial))
            final=planner.run(proposal,store=RunStore(store.path))
            self.assertTrue(final['completed']);self.assertTrue(verify_run(final))
            self.assertEqual(final['receipts'][0],partial['receipts'][0])
            self.assertEqual(planner.run(proposal,store=store),final)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):store.save(final,expected_head=partial['final_receipt'])

    def test_signed_snapshot_persistence_delta_and_quarantine(self):
        try:import cryptography
        except ImportError:self.skipTest('federation extra required')
        from nablamath.knowledge.identity import generate_signing_key,public_key_hex,PeerKey,sign_snapshot
        from nablamath.knowledge.federation import export_snapshot
        from nablamath.knowledge.versioned_claims import ClaimLedger,ClaimRevision
        from nablamath.knowledge.storage import SnapshotStore
        private=generate_signing_key();key=PeerKey('a',public_key_hex(private))
        ledger=ClaimLedger((ClaimRevision('c','hypothesis','proposed'),))
        envelope=sign_snapshot(export_snapshot(ledger,{},peer_id='a'),private)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            a,b=(SnapshotStore(Path(tmp)/name) for name in ('a.db','b.db'))
            a.pin(key);b.pin(key)
            self.assertTrue(a.ingest(envelope)['valid'])
            for row in a.delta(b.inventory()):self.assertTrue(b.ingest(row)['valid'])
            self.assertEqual(a.inventory(),b.inventory())
            self.assertEqual(a.delta(b.inventory()),[])
            self.assertEqual(len(SnapshotStore(b.path).reconcile()['snapshot_ids']),1)
            bad=copy.deepcopy(envelope);bad['signature']='00'*64
            self.assertTrue(b.ingest(bad)['quarantined'])
            self.assertEqual(len(b.quarantined()),1)
            b.pin(PeerKey('a',key.public_key,True))
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):SnapshotStore(b.path).delta()

class ResearchRecordTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_mixed_records_transaction_stream_and_tampering(self):
        from nablamath.datasets.research_record import make_research_record,ResearchRecord
        from nablamath.datasets.serializer import iter_load
        from nablamath.datasets.store import RecordStore
        from nablamath.worlds import ModelSpec,simulate_adaptive
        from nablamath.graphics.sampling import adaptive_function_scene
        ode=make_research_record('ode',simulate_adaptive(ModelSpec('exponential_decay',(1.,))),
            license_id='CC0-1.0',provenance='fixture',scope='ideal ODE',limitations='synthetic',synthetic=True,split='train')
        scene=make_research_record('scene',adaptive_function_scene('x*x').to_data(),
            license_id='CC0-1.0',provenance='fixture',scope='rational graph',limitations='synthetic',synthetic=True,split='train')
        altered=ode.to_data();altered['payload']['final'][0]=999
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):ResearchRecord.from_data(altered)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            store=RecordStore(Path(tmp)/'mixed.db');store.ingest([ode,scene],batch_id='mixed')
            path=Path(tmp)/'mixed.jsonl';store.export_jsonl(path)
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                actual=list(iter_load(stream))
            self.assertEqual({r.content_id for r in actual},{ode.content_id,scene.content_id})
            try:import pyarrow
            except ImportError:return
            from nablamath.export.parquet import write_parquet_stream,iter_parquet_stream
            arrow=Path(tmp)/'mixed.parquet';write_parquet_stream(store.records(),arrow,batch_size=1)
            self.assertEqual({r.content_id for r in iter_parquet_stream(arrow)},{ode.content_id,scene.content_id})
            with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):write_parquet_stream([ode],arrow)
            fail=Path(tmp)/'failed.parquet'
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):write_parquet_stream([ode,scene],fail,max_records=1)
            self.assertFalse(fail.exists())
            from nablamath.export.research_bundle import export_research_bundle,verify_research_bundle
            from nablamath.export.huggingface import prepare_hub
            release=Path(tmp)/'release'
            export_research_bundle([ode,scene],release)
            self.assertTrue(verify_research_bundle(release))
            self.assertFalse(prepare_hub(release)['publication_performed'])
            card=json.loads((release/'card.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            self.assertEqual(card['training_gain'],'not_established')
            card['training_gain']='invented gain'
            (release/'card.json').write_text(canonical_json(card),encoding='utf-8')
            manifest=json.loads((release/'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            import hashlib
            manifest['files']['card.json']=hashlib.sha256((release/'card.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            (release/'manifest.json').write_text(canonical_json(manifest),encoding='utf-8')
            self.assertFalse(verify_research_bundle(release))

class RationalIntegrationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_construction_independent_sympy_and_domain_guards(self):
        from nablamath.forge.constructors.rational_integration import construct,verify_primitive
        from nablamath.math.calculus.rational_functions import compare_rational
        result=compare_rational('(x*x-1)/(x-1)','x+1')
        self.assertTrue(result['equal_on_common_domain']);self.assertFalse(result['domain_equivalence_established'])
        for seed in (2,9,73):
            task,primitive=construct(seed,degree=3)
            self.assertTrue(verify_primitive(task,primitive))
            self.assertFalse(verify_primitive(task,'0'))
            # A removable new hole must not be accepted as a primitive over the task's domain.
            self.assertFalse(verify_primitive(task,f'({primitive})*(x-37)/(x-37)'))
            try:import sympy as sp
            except ImportError:continue
            x=sp.Symbol('x')
            self.assertEqual(sp.cancel(sp.diff(sp.sympify(primitive),x)-sp.sympify(task['integrand'])),0)


class NewDomainTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_elasticity_ac_kinetics_and_layers_replay(self):
        from nablamath.core.units import Quantity,ONE,METER,SECOND,KILOGRAM,VOLT
        from nablamath.domains.contracts import PASCAL,OHM
        from nablamath.domains.materials import isotropic_elasticity
        from nablamath.domains.circuits import series_rlc,HENRY,FARAD
        from nablamath.domains.chemistry import reversible_first_order,CONCENTRATION
        from nablamath.domains.earth import layered_hydrostatics
        from nablamath.knowledge.provenance_audit import replay_domain
        elastic=isotropic_elasticity(Quantity(1000,PASCAL),Quantity('1/4',ONE),[['1/1000',0,0],[0,0,0],[0,0,0]])
        self.assertEqual(elastic['outputs']['stress'][0][0],'6/5')
        ac=series_rlc(Quantity(10,OHM),Quantity(1,HENRY),Quantity(1,FARAD),Quantity(5,VOLT),Quantity(1,SECOND**-1))
        self.assertEqual(ac['outputs']['impedance_imaginary'],'0')
        self.assertAlmostEqual(ac['outputs']['current_real'],.5)
        kinetics=reversible_first_order(Quantity(1,CONCENTRATION),Quantity(0,CONCENTRATION),Quantity(1,SECOND**-1),Quantity(1,SECOND**-1),Quantity(1,SECOND))
        self.assertAlmostEqual(kinetics['outputs']['final'][0],.5+.5*math.exp(-2),places=7)
        layers=layered_hydrostatics([Quantity(2,METER),Quantity(3,METER)],[Quantity(1000,KILOGRAM/METER**3),Quantity(2000,KILOGRAM/METER**3)],Quantity(10,METER/SECOND**2),Quantity(0,PASCAL))
        self.assertEqual(layers['outputs']['interface_pressures'],['0','20000','80000'])
        for result in (elastic,ac,kinetics,layers):
            self.assertTrue(result['checks_passed']);self.assertTrue(replay_domain(result))


class MultimodalNetworkTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_actual_learning_pixel_ablation_checkpoint_and_target_blinding(self):
        try:import numpy
        except ImportError:self.skipTest('research extra required')
        from nablamath.training.multimodal_network import intersection_corpus,MultimodalNetwork,run_multimodal_study
        rows=intersection_corpus(32,seed=151)
        model=MultimodalNetwork(seed=2)
        before={k:v.copy() for k,v in model.weights.items()}
        model.fit(rows,steps=20)
        self.assertTrue(any(not numpy.array_equal(v,before[k]) for k,v in model.weights.items()))
        blinded=[{k:r[k] for k in ('equations','pixels')} for r in rows]
        self.assertEqual(model.predict(rows),model.predict(blinded))
        eq=MultimodalNetwork(seed=2,modalities=('equation',));prediction=eq.predict(blinded)
        changed=copy.deepcopy(blinded)
        for row in changed:row['pixels']=[1.]*512
        self.assertEqual(eq.predict(changed),prediction)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path=Path(tmp)/'model.npz';model.save(path)
            self.assertEqual(model.predict(blinded),MultimodalNetwork.load(path).predict(blinded))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):run_multimodal_study(rows,rows,steps=1)

class ExactRegressionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_weighted_fit_residual_orthogonality_and_nist(self):
        from nablamath.math.statistics.multivariate import exact_least_squares
        from fractions import Fraction
        fit=exact_least_squares([[0],[1],[2],[3]],[1,2,4,5],weights=[1,2,1,2])
        self.assertEqual(sum(w*r for w,r in zip([1,2,1,2],fit.residuals)),0)
        self.assertEqual(sum(w*x*r for w,x,r in zip([1,2,1,2],[0,1,2,3],fit.residuals)),0)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(fit.residual_sum_squares,0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):exact_least_squares([[1],[1],[1]],[1,2,3])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):exact_least_squares([[0],[1],[2]],[1,2,3],weights=[1,0,1])
        import importlib.util
        path=Path(__file__).parents[1]/'tools/validate_longley.py'
        spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('nabla_longley_validation',path)
        module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        report=module.validate(Path(__file__).parents[1]/'benchmarks/fixtures/longley-nist')
        self.assertTrue(report['passed'])
        self.assertLess(max(report['coefficient_relative_errors']),5e-12)


class PortfolioTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_fresh_holdout_receipts_promotion_rejection_and_contract(self):
        from nablamath.evolution.portfolio import PortfolioPolicy,select_portfolio,PortfolioCampaign
        from nablamath.forge.deduplicate import semantic_fingerprint
        family='linear_system';seen=set()
        def tasks(seed,count):
            result=[]
            for i in range(1000):
                task=generate_task(family,seed+i,3).task;key=semantic_fingerprint(task)
                if key in seen:continue
                seen.add(key);result.append(task)
                if len(result)==count:return result
            raise ValueError('Unique fixtures unavailable')
        train,holdout=tasks(100,3),tasks(2100,16)
        candidate,_=select_portfolio(train)
        baseline=PortfolioPolicy(((family,'alternate'),))
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            campaign=PortfolioCampaign(Path(tmp)/'campaign.db',baseline)
            receipt=campaign.evaluate(candidate,train,holdout)
            self.assertTrue(receipt['accepted'])
            altered=copy.deepcopy(receipt);altered['accepted']=False
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):campaign.promote(altered)
            self.assertEqual(campaign.promote(receipt),candidate)
            event=campaign.rollback(baseline.policy_id,reason='test operator reversal')
            self.assertEqual(event['to'],baseline.policy_id)
            self.assertEqual(campaign.active(),baseline)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):campaign.evaluate(candidate,train,holdout)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):PortfolioCampaign(campaign.path,baseline,minimum_effect=.99)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):campaign.rollback('0'*64,reason='unknown')

    def test_unknown_policy_capability_and_overlap_rejected(self):
        from nablamath.evolution.portfolio import PortfolioPolicy,PortfolioCampaign
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):PortfolioPolicy((('linear_system','eval'),))
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            policy=PortfolioPolicy((('linear_system','exact'),));campaign=PortfolioCampaign(Path(tmp)/'c.db',policy)
            task=generate_task('linear_system',1,2).task
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):campaign.evaluate(policy,[task],[task]*5)


class SignedReviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_pinned_revision_review_signature_and_conflict_policy(self):
        try:import cryptography
        except ImportError:self.skipTest('federation extra required')
        from nablamath.knowledge.identity import generate_signing_key,public_key_hex,PeerKey,PeerTrust
        from nablamath.knowledge.peer_review import Reviewer,Review,ReviewBoard,sign_review,submit_signed_review
        from nablamath.knowledge.versioned_claims import ClaimLedger,ClaimRevision
        claim=ClaimRevision('c','bounded claim','supported',('declared-evidence',));ledger=ClaimLedger((claim,))
        private=generate_signing_key();trust=PeerTrust((PeerKey('reviewer',public_key_hex(private)),))
        board=ReviewBoard((Reviewer('reviewer',('math',)),),authors={claim.revision_id:('author',)})

        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):submit_signed_review(board,tampered,ledger,trust)
        conflict=ReviewBoard((Reviewer('reviewer',('math',)),),authors={claim.revision_id:('reviewer',)})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):submit_signed_review(conflict,envelope,ledger,trust)


class CertifiedReferenceCheckoutTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_git_windows_line_endings_preserve_pinned_reference_bytes(self):
        import os
        import subprocess
        import hashlib
        from shutil import which
        if which('git') is None:self.skipTest('git unavailable for checkout test')
        root=Path(__file__).parents[1]
        if not (root/'.git').exists():self.skipTest('source archive has no Git index')
        reference='benchmarks/fixtures/longley-nist/Longley.dat'
        expected=hashlib.sha256((root/reference).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            env=dict(os.environ,GIT_INDEX_FILE=str(Path(tmp)/'isolated-index'))
            subprocess.run(['git','read-tree','HEAD'],cwd=root,env=env,check=True,capture_output=True)
            prefix=(Path(tmp)/'checkout').as_posix()+'/'
            subprocess.run(['git','-c','core.autocrlf=true','-c','core.eol=crlf','checkout-index','--force','--prefix='+prefix,'--',reference],
                           cwd=root,env=env,check=True,capture_output=True)
            self.assertEqual(hashlib.sha256((Path(prefix)/reference).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),expected)

def test_lattice_and_congruence_against_finite_definitions():
    from nablamath.ops.order_theory import order_theory
    from nablamath.ops.universal_algebra import universal_algebra
    relation=[[i==j or i==0 or j==4 for j in range(5)] for i in range(5)]
    result=order_theory(relation)
    assert result['is_lattice'] and result['joins'][1][2]==4 and result['meets'][1][2]==0
    assert len(result['covers'])==6
    with pytest.raises(ValueError,match='transitive'):
        order_theory([[True,True,False],[False,True,True],[False,False,True]])
    table=[[(i+j)%4 for j in range(4)] for i in range(4)]
    result=universal_algebra([table],generators=[1],partition=[0,1,0,1])
    assert result['generated_subalgebra']==[0,1,2,3]
    assert result['quotient_tables']==[[[0,1],[1,0]]]
    rejected=universal_algebra([table],partition=[0,0,1,1])
    assert rejected['congruence'] is False and rejected['counterexample']


def test_affine_scheme_cusp_and_polynomial_parser_rejects_code():
    from nablamath.ops.algebraic_geometry import algebraic_geometry
    singular=algebraic_geometry(['y**2-x**3'],['x','y'],[0,0])
    regular=algebraic_geometry(['y**2-x**3'],['x','y'],[1,1])
    assert singular['tangent_dimension']==2 and regular['tangent_dimension']==1
    assert regular['jacobian']==[[F(-3),F(2)]]
    assert sum(a*b for a,b in zip(regular['jacobian'][0],regular['tangent_basis'][0]))==0
    assert algebraic_geometry(['y-x*x'],['x','y'],[0,1])['tangent_basis'] is None
    for source in ['__import__("os")','x.__class__','x**1000','1/(x+1)']:
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):algebraic_geometry([source],['x'],[0])


def test_sl2_jacobi_killing_and_exact_bracket():
    from nablamath.ops.lie_algebra import lie_algebra
    c=[[[0,0,0],[0,2,0],[0,0,-2]],[[0,-2,0],[0,0,0],[1,0,0]],[[0,0,2],[-1,0,0],[0,0,0]]]
    result=lie_algebra(c,left=[0,1,0],right=[0,0,1])
    assert result['bracket']==[1,0,0] and result['center_basis']==[]
    assert result['killing_form']==[[8,0,0],[0,0,4],[0,4,0]]
    assert result['derived_dimension']==3 and result['semisimple_over_characteristic_zero']
    c[0][1][1]=3;c[1][0][1]=-3
    with pytest.raises(ValueError,match='Jacobi'):lie_algebra(c)


def test_graph_k0_sinks_loops_and_exact_integer_relations():
    from nablamath.ops.k_theory import k_theory
    assert k_theory([[0]])['K0_free_rank']==1
    assert k_theory([[1]])['K0_free_rank']==1
    assert k_theory([[2]])['K0_torsion']==[] and k_theory([[2]])['K0_free_rank']==0
    assert k_theory([[3]])['K0_torsion']==[2]
    assert k_theory([[0,1],[0,0]])['K0_free_rank']==1


def test_k0_determinantal_divisors_match_independent_smith_normal_form():
    sp=pytest.importorskip('sympy')
    from sympy.matrices.normalforms import smith_normal_form
    from nablamath.ops.k_theory import k_theory
    rng=random.Random(127)
    for n in (2,3,4):
        for _ in range(6):
            adjacency=[[rng.randrange(4) for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
            result=k_theory(adjacency)
            diagonal=smith_normal_form(sp.Matrix(result['presentation']),domain=sp.ZZ)
            reference=[abs(int(diagonal[i,i])) for i in range(min(diagonal.shape)) if diagonal[i,i]]
            assert result['invariant_factors']==reference

def test_finite_group_characters_match_independent_multivariate_dft():
    from nablamath.ops.abstract_harmonic_analysis import abstract_harmonic_analysis
    orders=[2,3];values=[1,2,3,4,5,6]
    reference=[sum(values[3*x+y]*cmath.exp(-2j*math.pi*(a*x/2+b*y/3)) for x in range(2) for y in range(3)) for a in range(2) for b in range(3)]
    result=abstract_harmonic_analysis(orders,values)
    assert [complex(*pair) for pair in result['values']]==pytest.approx(reference,abs=1e-12)
    restored=abstract_harmonic_analysis(orders,result['values'],inverse=True)
    assert [complex(*pair) for pair in restored['values']]==pytest.approx(values)

def test_euler_lagrange_against_independent_mechanics_equation():
    from nablamath.ops.variational_calculus import variational_calculus
    from nablamath.expression import evaluate,parse_expr
    result=variational_calculus('(t+1)*v**2/2-q**2/2')
    expression=parse_expr(result['euler_lagrange'])
    for t,q,v,a in [(0,2,3,4),(2,-3,7,-1),(5,0,2,0)]:
        assert evaluate(expression,{'t':t,'q':q,'v':v,'a':a})==(t+1)*a+v+q


def test_sphere_torus_projective_plane_and_singular_vertex_links():
    from nablamath.ops.manifold_topology import manifold_topology
    sphere=manifold_topology([[0,1,2],[0,1,3],[0,2,3],[1,2,3]])
    assert sphere['closed'] and sphere['components'][0]['orientable_genus']==0
    facets=[]
    index=lambda i,j:(i%3)*3+j%3
    for i in range(3):
        for j in range(3):
            a,b,c,d=index(i,j),index(i+1,j),index(i,j+1),index(i+1,j+1)
            facets.extend([[a,b,c],[b,d,c]])
    torus=manifold_topology(facets)
    assert torus['closed'] and torus['euler_characteristic']==0 and torus['components'][0]['orientable_genus']==1
    rp=[[0,1,2],[0,1,3],[0,2,4],[0,3,5],[0,4,5],[1,2,5],[1,3,4],[1,4,5],[2,3,4],[2,3,5]]
    projective=manifold_topology(rp)
    assert projective['closed'] and not projective['orientable'] and projective['components'][0]['nonorientable_crosscaps']==1
    assert not manifold_topology([[0,1,2],[0,3,4]])['is_surface_with_boundary']


def test_discrete_hodge_theorem_and_exact_harmonic_projection():

import hashlib

def checkout(tmp_path):
    subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',str(tmp_path)],check=True)
    (tmp_path/'.gitignore').write_text('.venv/\n.nabla/\nsecret.py\n')
    return tmp_path


def put(root,name,data):
    path = root/name
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes(data)
    return path


def test_collects_all_source_components_and_excludes_local_data(tmp_path):
    root = checkout(tmp_path)
    wanted = ['src/nablamath/a.py','tests/test_a.py','services/a.py','sdk/a.rs',
              'legacy/a.py','website/app.js','tools/a.py','lean/A.lean',
              'packaging/windows/app.iss','configs/profile.yaml','protocol/schema/a.json',
              'templates/report/example.document.json','website/package.json','examples/plan.json']
    for name in wanted:
        put(root,name,b'content\n')
    for name in ['.venv/library.py','.nabla/run.py','secret.py','math.txt','NABLA.TXT',
                 'website/dist/app.js','sdk/rust/target/build.rs','benchmarks/results/run.json',
                 'docs/guide.md','image.png']:
        put(root,name,b'excluded\n')
    paths = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in bundle.source_paths(root)}
    assert paths == set(wanted)|{'.gitignore'}
    data = bundle.build_bundle(root)
    manifest = bundle.inspect_bundle(data)
    assert manifest['file_count'] == len(wanted)+1
    assert {row['path'] for row in manifest['files']} == paths

    manifest = bundle.inspect_bundle(data)

def test_release_sources_have_checkout_independent_line_endings():
    """The byte archive must remain current after a Windows checkout."""
    paths = bundle.source_paths(ROOT)
    payload = b''.join(p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix().encode()+b'\0' for p in paths)
    raw = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'check-attr', '-z', '--stdin', 'text', 'eol'],
                                  cwd=ROOT, input=payload)
    fields = raw.decode().split('\0')
    attrs = {}
    for index in range(0, len(fields)-1, 3):
        name, attribute, value = fields[index:index+3]
        attrs.setdefault(name, {})[attribute] = value
    for path in paths:
        name = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        policy = attrs[name]
        if policy['text'] == 'unset':  # Frozen history is deliberately byte-preserved.
            continue
        assert policy['eol'] in {'lf', 'crlf'}, name
        data = path.read_bytes()
        if policy['eol'] == 'lf':
            assert b'\r\n' not in data, name
        else:
            assert b'\n' not in data.replace(b'\r\n', b''), name

import math
import unittest
from fractions import Fraction

from nablamath.autodiff import jvp
from nablamath.numeric.linear import solve_exact
from nablamath.numeric.ode import refine_error


class NumericTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_linear_known_solution_and_singular(self):
        self.assertEqual(solve_exact([[2, 1], [1, -1]], [5, 1]), (2, 1))
        self.assertEqual(solve_exact([[2, 0], [0, 3]], [1, 1]),
                         (Fraction(1, 2), Fraction(1, 3)))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            solve_exact([[1, 2], [2, 4]], [3, 6])

    def test_rk4_converges_on_exp(self):
        value, indicator = refine_error(lambda t,y:y, 1, 0, 1, 10)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(value, math.e, delta=1e-6)
        self.assertLess(indicator, 1e-5)

    def test_jvp_matches_analytic_and_finite_difference(self):
        value, derivative = jvp(lambda x:x*x*x+2*x, 3, 1)
        self.assertEqual((value, derivative), (33, 29))
        h = 1e-5
        fd = (((3+h)**3+2*(3+h))-((3-h)**3+2*(3-h)))/(2*h)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(derivative, fd, places=8)

def test_macro_receipt_sink_replay_and_closed_actions():

    with CalculationSession(receipt_sink=observed.append) as session:
        result = session.execute('omni_superintelligence', action='verify_chain_of_thought',

def test_truncated_causal_distribution_differs_from_conditioning():
    from fractions import Fraction
    model = o.CausalStructuralModel(
        {'Z': [0, 1], 'X': [0, 1], 'Y': [0, 1]},
        {'X': ['Z'], 'Y': ['Z']},
        {'Z': {(): {0: '1/2', 1: '1/2'}},
         'X': {(0,): {0: 1, 1: 0}, (1,): {0: 0, 1: 1}},
         'Y': {(0,): {0: 1, 1: 0}, (1,): {0: 0, 1: 1}}})
    assert model.do_calculus('Y', {'X': 1}) == {0: Fraction(1, 2), 1: Fraction(1, 2)}
    assert model.do_calculus('X', {'X': 1}) == {0: 0, 1: 1}
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        o.CausalStructuralModel({'X': [0, 1]}, {'X': ['X']}, {'X': {}})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        model.do_calculus('Y', {'X': 3})


def test_sparse_gp_and_acquisition_uncertainty():
    np = pytest.importorskip('numpy')
    x = np.linspace(-2, 2, 50)[:, None]; y = np.sin(x[:, 0])
    gp = o.SparseGaussianProcessSurrogate(x[::5], noise=1e-4)
    gp.partial_fit(x[:25], y[:25]); gp.partial_fit(x[25:], y[25:])
    mean, variance = gp.predict(x)
    assert np.max(np.abs(mean-y)) < .04
    assert np.min(variance) >= 0
    _, far = gp.predict([[10]])
    assert far[0] > variance.max()
    acquisition = o.ActiveAcquisitionOptimizer()
    assert np.allclose(acquisition.score([1, -1], [0, 0]), [1, 0])
    assert np.allclose(acquisition.score([1], [4], method='ucb'), [5])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        acquisition.score([0], [-1])


def test_notears_reports_acyclic_output():
    np = pytest.importorskip('numpy'); pytest.importorskip('scipy')
    rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
    x = rng.normal(size=(500, 3)); x[:, 1] += 2*x[:, 0]; x[:, 2] += 1.5*x[:, 1]
    result = o.NOTEARSDiscovery().fit(x, max_iter=15)
    w = result['weights']
    assert np.all(np.diag(w) == 0)
    assert not (np.linalg.matrix_power((w != 0).astype(int), 3).trace())
    assert result['causal_identification'] is False


def test_neural_fft_and_training_are_real_and_seeded():
    torch = pytest.importorskip('torch')
    np = pytest.importorskip('numpy')
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    layer = o.SpectralConv2d(1, 1, 2, 2, seed=5)
    x = torch.zeros((1, 1, 8, 8)); x[:, :, :, :] = 1
    output = layer(x)
    assert output.shape == x.shape and torch.isfinite(output).all()
    assert torch.allclose(output, output.mean().expand_as(output), atol=1e-6)
    x = torch.randn(1, 1, 8, 8, generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(3), requires_grad=True)
    layer(x).square().sum().backward()
    assert x.grad.abs().sum() > 0 and layer.weights1.grad.abs().sum() > 0
    model = o.NeuralOperatorModule()
    training = model.train(np.ones((2, 1, 4, 4)), np.zeros((2, 1, 4, 4)), epochs=15, width=4, modes=2, layers=1)
    assert training['losses'][-1] < training['losses'][0]
    duplicate = o.NeuralOperatorModule().train(np.ones((2, 1, 4, 4)), np.zeros((2, 1, 4, 4)), epochs=15, width=4, modes=2, layers=1)
    assert duplicate['weights_hash'] == training['weights_hash']
    assert o.DeepONet(4, 2, 8)(torch.ones(3, 4), torch.ones(5, 2)).shape == (3, 5)

    pytest.importorskip('numpy')
    script = '''

def test_physics_residual_ad_and_conservation_fail_closed():
    np = pytest.importorskip('numpy')
    enforcer = o.PhysicsInformedEnforcer()
    assert np.allclose(enforcer.compute_pde_residual(np.ones((3, 3, 3, 2)), 'burgers'), 0)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match='aborted'):
        enforcer.enforce_conservation_law([1, 1.1])
    assert not enforcer.enforce_conservation_law([0, 0])['violation']
    fallback = o.PhysicsInformedEnforcer(exact_fallback=lambda _: {'exact': True})
    assert fallback.enforce_conservation_law([0, 1])['exact_result'] == {'exact': True}
    extreme = fallback.enforce_conservation_law([-1e308, 1e308])
    assert extreme['violation'] and extreme['relative_drift'] == 2
    assert fallback.enforce_conservation_law([1e-308, 1e308])['relative_drift'] is None
    torch = pytest.importorskip('torch')
    coordinates = torch.tensor([[0., 1., 2.], [1., 2., 3.]], requires_grad=True)
    field = lambda c: torch.stack([c[:, 1]**2, c[:, 2]*0], -1)
    residual = enforcer.compute_pde_residual(field, 'burgers', coordinates=coordinates)
    assert torch.allclose(residual[:, 0], 2*coordinates[:, 1]**3-.02)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        enforcer.compute_pde_residual(field, coordinates=coordinates)


def test_radiance_variance_exr_binary_and_integrity(tmp_path):
    np = pytest.importorskip('numpy')
    tracer = o.CertifiedSpectralPathTracer({'environment': 2., 'spheres': []}, seed=3)
    image = tracer.render(3, 2, 3)
    assert np.all(image['image'] == 2) and not image['variance'].any()
    path = tmp_path/'radiance.exr'
    with CalculationSession() as session:
        audit = tracer.export_openexr_with_receipt(image, path, session)
    assert verify_receipt(audit)
    data = path.read_bytes()
    assert struct.unpack('<II', data[:8]) == (20000630, 2)
    offset = 8; attrs = {}
    while data[offset]:
        end = data.index(b'\0', offset); name = data[offset:end].decode(); offset = end+1
        end = data.index(b'\0', offset); kind = data[offset:end].decode(); offset = end+1
        size = struct.unpack_from('<I', data, offset)[0]; offset += 4
        attrs[name] = (kind, data[offset:offset+size]); offset += size
    assert attrs['nablaReceiptSHA256'][1].decode() == audit['content_id']
    assert json.loads(attrs['nablaReceipt'][1]) == audit
    first_row = struct.unpack_from('<Q', data, offset+1)[0]
    assert struct.unpack_from('<ii', data, first_row) == (0, 3*64*4)
    floats = np.frombuffer(data, dtype='<f4', offset=first_row+8, count=3*64).reshape(64, 3)
    assert np.all(floats[:32] == 2) and np.all(floats[32:] == 0)
    with CalculationSession() as session, pytest.raises(FileExistsError):
        tracer.export_openexr_with_receipt(image, path, session)
    medium = o.VolumetricMedia(.2, .3, .1)
    assert np.allclose(medium.transmittance(2), math.exp(-1))
    assert medium.phase(.5) > 0
    volume = o.CertifiedSpectralPathTracer(media=medium).render(2, 2, 4, device='cpu')
    assert np.isfinite(volume['image'].numpy()).all()


def test_surface_path_mis_bsdf_and_variance():

    tracer = o.CertifiedSpectralPathTracer({'environment': 1., 'spheres': [
